description: What the role is: As a Talent Acquisition Sourcer at GovTech Singapore, you will play a pivotal role in identifying and engaging top-tier tech talent to drive our mission of building Tech for Public Good. You will be a hands-on partner, focusing on the crucial initial stages of the recruitment lifecycle, and contributing to the transformation of how GovTech attracts and secures the best minds in the industry. This role requires a strategic approach to talent identification, balancing immediate hiring needs with the long-term development of our talent pipelines. This will initially start off as a 12-month contract. What you'll be working on: Your primary responsibilities will include: Strategic Sourcing: Design and execute innovative sourcing strategies to identify passive and active candidates for highly specialized tech roles, including but not limited to Software Engineering, Cybersecurity, Data Science, and Cloud Architecture. Talent Mapping & Market Intelligence: Conduct in-depth talent mapping exercises and gather market intelligence to understand talent landscapes, identify key organizations, and pinpoint emerging talent pools relevant to GovTech's strategic objectives. Candidate Engagement: Craft compelling outreach messages and engage potential candidates through various channels, building strong relationships and effectively communicating GovTech's value proposition and mission. Pipeline Development: Proactively build and nurture robust talent pipelines for both immediate hiring needs and future critical roles, ensuring a continuous flow of qualified candidates. Collaboration & Partnership: Work closely with Talent Acquisition Partners and hiring managers to understand specific role requirements, team dynamics, and strategic priorities, translating these into effective sourcing plans. Process Optimization: Contribute to the continuous improvement of sourcing processes, tools, and systems, leveraging data and insights to enhance efficiency, candidate experience, and overall recruitment effectiveness. Employer Branding: Act as an ambassador for GovTech, promoting our unique culture, values (Agile, Bold, Collaborative), and the impact of working on projects that serve the public good. What we are looking for: We are seeking a highly motivated and results-oriented individual with a passion for connecting talent with purpose. The ideal candidate will possess: Proven Sourcing Expertise: A solid track record in talent sourcing, preferably within the technology sector, with demonstrated success in identifying and engaging candidates for niche and hard-to-fill roles. Technical Acumen: A strong understanding of various tech domains and roles (e.g., software development, product management, design, data engineering, cybersecurity etc) to effectively identify and assess relevant talent. Strategic Mindset: Ability to think strategically about talent acquisition challenges and develop creative, data-driven sourcing solutions. Communication & Influence: Excellent communication, interpersonal, and negotiation skills, with the ability to build rapport quickly and influence potential candidates. Stakeholder Management: Experience working effectively with hiring managers and internal stakeholders, providing insights and guiding them through the sourcing process. Tool Proficiency: Proficiency in using various sourcing tools and platforms, including LinkedIn Recruiter, applicant tracking systems (ATS), and other online databases and social media channels. Data-Driven Approach: A commitment to using data and metrics to inform sourcing strategies, track performance, and report on key talent insights. Alignment with GovTech Values: A genuine interest in GovTech's mission of Tech for Public Good and an embodiment of our Agile, Bold, and Collaborative values. Project Management Skills: Ability to lead or contribute to projects aimed at enhancing recruitment efficiency and candidate experience. Join us in shaping Singapore's digital future!

At MOE, we are working to enhance Mother Tongue Language (MTL) education through the thoughtful application of AI technologies. As a Senior AI Product Manager, you will partner with the Mother Tongue Languages Branch (MTLB) to lead the design, development, and integration of AI-enhanced MTL learning solutions that support how students learn languages. You will work closely with curriculum specialists to ensure AI solutions are pedagogically sound and aligned with educational needs. At the same time, you will bring strong product management skills and technical appreciation to guide the development, piloting, evaluation, and scaling of these solutions. This role requires cross-functional collaboration, structured implementation, and data-informed decision-making — helping MOE deliver practical, scalable AI/EdTech tools that improve language learning outcomes. Key Responsibilities 1. Strategic Planning and Implementation Partner with curriculum specialists to co-develop AI/EdTech initiatives that are pedagogically grounded and learner-centric. Translate learning goals into clear product requirements while balancing feasibility, scalability, and resource considerations. Develop a standardized evaluation framework to assess initiatives across both pedagogical and technical dimensions. Establish clear processes for procurement, development, piloting, and implementation of AI enhanced learning tools. 2. Technology Partnership and Product Management Act as the key product liaison between MTLB, DXD, vendors, and other internal and external stakeholders. Coordinate with technical experts to align system architecture, AI models, integration, and compliance requirements with educational goals. Shape product direction by contributing strategic input and ensuring alignment across technical, pedagogical, and user needs. Translate product and curriculum requirements into clear technical specifications to inform procurement and vendor deliverables. 3. Project and Resource Management Oversee project execution, including milestone planning, timelines, budgeting, and risk mitigation. Manage procurement and contract administration for AI/EdTech initiatives in collaboration with MOE stakeholders. Coordinate day-to-day delivery across internal teams and vendors to ensure timely, high quality implementation of AI solutions in schools. 4. Evaluation and Scaling Support the planning, execution, and analysis of pilot initiatives. Develop robust evaluation frameworks to assess impact and guide decisions on scaling. Synthesise feedback into actionable insights that strengthen future deployments. 5. Stakeholder Engagement and Change Leadership Facilitate effective communication between curriculum teams, product and technical teams, and external partners. Present updates and recommendations to senior management. Manage expectations, align stakeholders, and lead change management efforts to support smooth adoption of new tools. Job Expectations User-Centric Focus: Design AI solutions that address educators’ needs and improve both teaching effectiveness and student learning. Strategic Thinking: Develop clear, scalable adoption strategies that align with MOE’s educational goals. Product and Technical Fluency: Demonstrate strong product leadership with an appreciation for AI/ML technologies and their practical application in education. Collaboration and Communication: Build strong partnerships across MOE and external stakeholders, and communicate clearly across technical and educational domains. Data-Informed Approach: Leverage analytics and pilot results to refine strategies and scale effective solutions. Project Management: Drive efficient, high-quality execution of multiple AI initiatives in alignment with curriculum priorities. Required Qualifications and Experience Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Science, Education Technology, or a related field; Master’s degree preferred. At least 5 years of experience in product management, preferably involving AI/ML solutions or EdTech platforms. Proven track record of designing, developing, and implementing digital products at scale. Experience working in cross-functional teams with designers, engineers, curriculum specialists, and external vendors. Strong understanding of AI/ML technologies and their applications in education, including ethics, compliance, and data privacy considerations. Skilled in agile methodologies, product lifecycle management, and iterative pilot-to-scale implementation. Excellent communication, stakeholder engagement, and influence skills. These products support business-critical internal workflows (knowledge management, record management) or underpin key industry-facing services (e.g., grants management and licensing), enabling officers to deliver reliable services to the tourism sector. You are accountable for defining product direction and driving successful delivery, adoption and measurable outcomes for your product area. Product Strategy & Ownership Define and evolve product vision, roadmap and priorities for your product area to improve internal productivity and service outcomes. Translate operational needs into clear user stories, acceptance criteria and success metrics; maintain a prioritised backlog. Own the product lifecycle end-to-end (discovery → build → launch → iteration), ensuring outcomes are realised post-launch. Delivery Accountability Be accountable for delivery outcomes for your product area, including scope, timelines, quality, and operational readiness, working in partnership with engineering/delivery leads. Drive delivery planning with the team (milestones, release plan, dependencies) and keep stakeholders informed of progress and risks. Ensure solutions are production-ready by working with engineering, architecture, security and operations on non-functional and run requirements (security, performance, supportability). Identify opportunities for automation, standardisation and reuse to improve productivity and reduce errors. Align stakeholders across policy, operations and technology on priorities, timelines and release scope; drive timely decisions. Define and track productivity and service metrics (e.g., turnaround time, throughput, backlog, error rates, adoption) and use insights to guide iteration. Ensure delivered changes achieve intended operational outcomes and are embedded into business-as-usual operations. Contribute to reusable components and common patterns across internal workflow products to avoid siloed solutions. Governance, Risk & Compliance Ensure compliance with audit, data protection and security requirements; maintain traceability for financial and regulatory workflows. Identify and manage product and operational risks; ensure controls are designed into workflows without excessive burden on users. Strong execution and delivery discipline: plans work, manages risks and dependencies, and drives issues to resolution. jobTitle: Scientist / Centre for Animal & Veterinary Sciences (Contract)
responsibilities: You will be part of the Centre for Animal and Veterinary Sciences (CAVS) team under the Professional and Scientific Services Division of AVS. As a member of the trans-disciplinary team at CAVS, you will be responsible for providing professional and competent laboratory diagnostic and research support for animal and zoonotic disease biosurveillance programmes, various research projects with national and international partners, as well as laboratory services for external customers with the objective of meeting NParks mission to create the best living environment through excellence in nature conservation, greenery and recreation, and veterinary care, in partnership with the community. Duties include: Undertake assigned projects for method establishment/validation and molecular pathogen characterization. Perform laboratory diagnostic analysis, in support of disease outbreak investigations and biosurveillance programmes. To develop, establish, and validate test protocols for higher order pathogen characterization e.g. Next-Generation Sequencing (NGS) and other sequencing platforms for the genetic/genomic analysis of veterinary and zoonotic pathogens, in various sample types including environmental samples (e-DNA and e-RNA pipelines). To transfer the applied research analysis pipelines for use in biosurveillance programs and disease investigation. Participate in the maintenance of a quality assurance system in compliance with ISO/IEC 17025:2017.
requirements: Areas of study in Biology, Biotechnology, Biomedical Science, Life Science, or related fields, with minimum one to two years of hands-on experience in a relevant veterinary, medical or research laboratory preferred. Highly motivated individual with passion for laboratory work. Team player with initiative, drive and good interpersonal/communication skills and able to work independently. Proficient in IT skills e.g. Microsoft Office. Office Location: Animal & Plant Health Centre, 6 Perahu Road Singapore 718827 Only shortlisted candidates will be notified. Successful candidates will be offered a 11-month employment contract.
description: The Animal & Veterinary Service (AVS), a cluster of NParks, safeguards the health and welfare of animals through comprehensive and integrated programmes and works closely with partners in the veterinary and animal-related industries to strengthen capacities and enhance competencies in animal health and welfare. It is the main touchpoint on animal and veterinary matters in Singapore and the first responder for all animal-related feedback. It also conducts public education and engagement programmes to foster a society where pet owners, communities, and animals co-exist in our City in Nature.

description: The Internal Audit Unit (IAU) in KidStart Singapore (KSL) is responsible for providing independent and objective assurance and consulting services to KSL management. The IAU helps KSL accomplish its objectives by bringing a systematic, disciplined approach to evaluate and improve the effectiveness of risk management, control, and governance processes. The IAU's main responsibilities include conducting internal audits and providing advisory services. Internal audits are conducted to assess the adequacy and effectiveness of internal controls, compliance with policies and procedures and Code of Governance for Charities and Institutions of Public Character, and the reliability and integrity of financial and operational information. You will assist Head/IAU by working with the KSL Audit and Risk Committee (ARC) and Management to improve governance, risk management and streamline processes for greater operational effectiveness and efficiency.

Job Description IMDA is spearheading Singapore’s drive to be a world leading Digital Economy. IMDA aims to empower our companies and workforce with digital technologies and enable Singapore to be a leading Digital Economy in the global area. As part of the Business and Ecosystems Division, the incumbent plays a key role in supporting win-win propositions for ecosystem partnerships that elevate the industrial adoption of Emerging Technologies – such as artificial intelligence, advanced communications, trust tech, green computing, and quantum technologies. The ideal candidate should possess strong logical thinking and a creative mindset for problem solving. A track record in engagements driving digital transformation and/or implementing new emerging technologies for enterprises would be an added advantage. Responsibilities Work across multi-disciplinary teams to drive enterprise adoption of emerging technologies. Some key aspects of work include: Building and managing business relationships with key industry stakeholders, including technology partners, end-users and research teams. Market products, solutions and related technologies to potential end-users. Supporting the commercialisation of emerging technologies generated through partnerships with industry and academic research. Other supporting initiatives necessary for the exploitation and adoption of emerging technologies developed, e.g. building new business models, bringing together new ecosystem partners. Requirements At least 2-3 years of relevant working experience – such as in Management/Technology Consulting, Digital Innovation, Project Management and/or Strategic Planning. Experience in ecosystem level partnership management, project and vendor management. Demonstrate the ability to articulate the value of emerging technologies for enterprise transformation. Results-oriented and the ability to work across multi-disciplinary teams. Ability to work independently and multi-task across multiple projects. #LI-FN1

responsibilities: 1. Identify potential issues/ areas for improvement to enhance facilities operations, building maintenance standards and efficiency and propose viable solutions/ suggestions. 8.Track & update inventory of building assets. 9. Coordinate and handle users’ requests & feedbacks and to ensure timely updates/ closure with the users. 10. Maintain good records / archives of all work & contractual correspondence.

[LTA-DPO] TECHNICAL PM / PRINCIPAL / SENIOR ENGINEER, PROJECT
pcfCompetencies: Sourcing and tendering; Contract management; Supplier and vendor management
responsibilities: Join a team of changemakers on a mission to redesign the motoring experience – creating a future where transactions happen effortlessly, touchpoints are thoughtfully designed, and where every interaction in a delight. You will be part of a team to reinvent the One Motoring platform, building new capabilities to enable real-time billing, personalised dashboards, and intuitive user flows. You will coordinate and manage resources, lifecycles, and budgets while liaising between design, technical, product, and business teams to drive successful project execution that enables large-scale digital change. What You’ll Do Project Leadership: Oversee the full project lifecycle, from initial conceptualisation and solution design through to implementation and ongoing system maintenance. Procurement & Vendor Management: Build strong partnerships by leading procurement processes, crafting robust tender specifications, and fostering vendor relationships that drive exceptional project outcomes. Stakeholder Management: Lead stakeholder engagement and manage relationships across internal and external partners to ensure sustained alignment and buy-in. Lead Technical Tests: Perform code and architecture reviews and lead software testing. You will approve test plans proposed by the vendors and supervise the testing process. Support Agile Software Development: Define and drive agile best practices with the vendor, bridging communication between designers, architects, and the vendors. Track Deliverables & Milestones: Maintain clear project timelines, monitor deliverables, ensure project documentation is maintained and proactively manage risks. Risk & Compliance Management: Identify and mitigate project risks while ensuring adherence to government IT governance, frameworks, and contractual obligations.
requirements: Knowledge in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent technical background. You have 7+ years of experience with at least 3 years in technical project management, senior or lead roles, preferably within government or regulated industries. You must have a Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Systems, or equivalent technical background with demonstrated expertise in enterprise-scale systems. You have extensive experience managing complex procurement processes exceeding $1M in value, including multi-vendor contract management, change management. Knowledge of public sector regulations and compliance frameworks is preferred. You must have strong technical acumen and can conduct code reviews and architecture assessments. You have hands-on experience with cloud platforms (AWS/Azure/GCP), microservices architecture, and modern DevSecOps practices including CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and security scanning tools. You are certified in agile methodologies (Scrum Master, Product Owner, or equivalent) with proven experience scaling agile practices across large, distributed teams. You have deep expertise in software design principles, enterprise architecture patterns, API design and complex system integrations. You have excellent stakeholder management skills , with the ability to communicate effectively with vendors, engineers, cross-functional teams, and the product leadership. You are highly organised and detail-oriented and can deftly manage multiple asks and workstreams while keeping projects on track. You are strategically minded with strong business acumen , capable of translating technical complexities into business value propositions. You have experience with budget management, resource planning, and can effectively manage multiple concurrent projects worth millions in combined value while maintaining rigorous quality standards. As part of the shortlisting process for the role, you may be required to complete a medical declaration and / or undergo further assessment.

responsibilities: Key responsibilities include: Engage internal and external stakeholders to gather project requirements and conduct market surveys where necessary. Design system architectures and formulate technical specifications for assigned project(s). Support the design of integration solutions between various systems, applications, and databases using APIs, middleware, and other relevant technologies. Support the identification and resolution of integration issues to ensure system stability and reliability. Support the coordination and monitoring of integrated system performance, as well as the development of integration testing plans. Seek approvals from relevant authorities for procurement, system design, and technical specifications, as required. Ensure timely project delivery in accordance with approved scope, schedule, and budget, while meeting operational needs and objectives. Identify project risks, assess their impact, and recommend mitigation measures to minimise delays and operational impact. Review and ensure that project documentation (e.g. system design documents, site acceptance test documents, interface control documents) is accurate, complete, and delivered on time. Engage stakeholders to ensure systems are properly integrated, tested, and ready to support air traffic operations. Provide regular project updates to management and highlight potential issues and proposed resolutions in a timely manner.
requirements: Degree or Diploma in Engineering (Computing, Electrical, Electronics, Telecommunications), Information Technology, Computer Science, or equivalent relevant experience. Experience delivering large-scale ICT systems across the full system lifecycle, including working with vendors and contractors on design reviews, implementation oversight, testing, acceptance, and operational handover. Knowledge of system architecture design, system administration, networking, cybersecurity, and/or the air traffic management domain is an advantage. Professional certifications such as Cloud Solution Architect, SysOps Administrator, Project Management Professional (PMP), Agile Project Management, Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP), or equivalent are advantageous. Self-motivated, with a strong sense of ownership and accountability; able to work independently and collaboratively as a team player. Good written, verbal, interpersonal, analytical, presentation, and negotiation skills, with a positive attitude and attention to detail. Willingness to travel overseas occasionally. Your appointment designation will commensurate with your relevant work experience. Successful candidates will be offered a 3-year contract in the first instance and may be considered for placement on a permanent tenure or subsequent contract renewal.
description: The Next Generation Programme Office (NGPO) in CAAS is seeking a strong, driven, and dynamic engineer to be part of the Info-Centric Air Traffic Management (iATM) workstream. You will be part of the team overseeing the implementation of Next Generation iATM systems, including (but not limited to) flight plan filing and air traffic flow management. You will play a key role across multiple phases of the project lifecycle, such as approvals, procurement, implementation, testing, maintenance, and system enhancements. Depending on the project phase, you will work with relevant stakeholders to define system architectures, gather requirements, formulate technical specifications, manage procurement processes, and oversee system implementation, commissioning, maintenance, and enhancements in accordance with Singapore Government and applicable international standards (e.g. SG IM8, ICAO). You will also support the implementation of cyber and data security measures and contribute to the safe and efficient management of air traffic in Singapore.

responsibilities: As the principal agency that safeguards Singapore’s integrity as a world-class financial and commercial centre through vigilant and professional enforcement of the laws, the Commercial Affairs Department (CAD) offers a number of exciting opportunities and challenges through the following job functions: • Financial Intelligence Analysis – Officers can look forward to developing data analytical capabilities to detect criminal activities and disseminate timely financial intelligence to domestic authorities to commence investigation. Officers will also be exposed to building partnerships with the private sector in strengthening Singapore’s suspicious transaction reporting regime and collaborating with international and regional stakeholders to combat money laundering and terrorism financing. • Investigation – Officers will assist in criminal legal proceedings arising from investigations into commercial fraud and abuses, and liaise with organisations such as banks, law firms, audit firms, as well as government and quasi-government agencies to maintain the integrity of the economic structure in Singapore.
requirements: • Relevant background • A good command of both spoken and written English • Meticulous, with strong analytical skills • Good communication and interpersonal skills Note: Our officers may be deployed to frontline positions or have frequent interactions with members of the public. Candidates who are not fully vaccinated and do not intend to get vaccinated have higher risk of COVID complications and will not be considered for the position. APPLICATION To be part of our team, please submit an online application via www.careers.gov.sg. Short-listed candidates will be notified within two weeks after the closing date of applications.
description: Want to create a difference in Singapore’s Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Financing of Terrorism efforts? Have an inquisitive and strong analytical mind to sense-make voluminous data and information from multiple sources, to detect crimes and money laundering activities? – JOIN US as a Commercial Affairs Officer. The SPF plays a critical role in keeping Singapore safe and secure, with our mission to prevent, deter and detect crime. As a Commercial Affairs Officer in the CAD, you can look forward to a challenging career in financial crime investigation, financial intelligence analysis and policy formulation. You play an important role in proactively preventing and deterring criminals from abusing our financial system and detecting these criminal activities efficiently. Structured training programmes are provided for new Commercial Affairs Officers on financial crime investigation, financial intelligence analysis and key legislation enforced by CAD. At the appropriate juncture, officers will be given the opportunity for job rotation and secondment.

pcfCompetencies: Supplier and vendor management; Procurement operations
responsibilities: We are looking for strong and dynamic candidates to be part of the Digital Development team in CAAS’ Transformation Office. Together, you will help to achieve CAAS’ digital transformation strategic outcomes – by supporting our IT modernisation efforts and overseeing the maintenance and support of existing enterprise IT application systems. You will be working closely with business users and vendors, ensuring system compliance with government IM8 policies, and identifying improvements to enhance business operations and delivery of CAAS’ e-services. This role requires a blend of technical expertise, project management skills, and business acumen to manage ICT systems that support CAAS's operational excellence. Key responsibilities include: 1) Support the maintenance and support of CAAS enterprise IT systems. This requires: - working closely with CAAS business users in scoping user requirements - budgeting and procurement of professional services to maintain and support ICT systems - strong project management and stakeholder engagement to ensure timely delivery and cost effectiveness 2) Manage CAAS’ ICT vendors to ensure high quality delivery of services 3) Support maintenance of existing CAAS enterprise IT systems to ensure their smooth operations and availability, including management of contracts and change/service requests 4) Ensure that CAAS enterprise IT systems comply with prevailing government IM8 policies and requirements 5) Regularly identify and exploit appropriate technology, review and improve customers' work processes and conduct business process re-engineering when required
requirements: Requirements Trained in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering (Computing/Telecommunication) or equivalent At least 3 years of relevant working experience in IT project management in the scoping, design, development, implementation and maintenance of web-based application systems Minimum 2 years of IT knowledge in Web Development, Cloud Technologies, Cloud Security, Agile Methodology, Database Management, and Troubleshooting and Technical Support Working knowledge of Cloud Service Providers, Cybersecurity, and ICT governance will be an added advantage Good knowledge of computer concepts such as Operating Systems, Networking, Virtualization, Web Technologies, Deployment and DevOps, Security Best Practices, Self-motivated, driven, adaptable to change, with problem-solving mindset, good team player and strong ability to multi-task Good verbal, written communication and interpersonal skills, with experience in stakeholder management and technical documentation Good analytical, presentation and negotiation skills, including vendor management experience Note: Your appointment designation will commensurate with your relevant work experience. Successful candidates will be offered a 3-year contract in the first instance, and may be considered for placement on a permanent tenure or subsequent contract renewal.
description: To ensure that CAAS continues to be a high-performing and future-ready organisation, we are digitally transforming the way CAAS staff work using new digital tools and services, and how the public engages with CAAS through citizen-centric e-services.

responsibilities: You will be part of the team to manage the procurement and administration at the Centre for Animal Rehabilitation. You will be required to manage all essential procurement functions for the centre’s operations, which include formulating and publishing tenders and purchases, while ensuring compliance with government procurement policies and procedure. You will also be required to manage the general administration and logistical support for the centre. As part of your daily work, you will also be assisting with the following: Manage procurement operations, including quotation and tender exercises and contract management. Support the management and upkeep of the shelter clinic, including inventory management of drugs and consumables. Oversee the general administration of the centre, including animal record keeping. Data management and analysis, regular maintenance and upkeep of facilities and equipment and workplace health and safety. Assist with the different duties, activities and programmes related to the Centre.
requirements: Experience in procurement operations such as managing tenders, contract management and procurement governance in the public sector preferred. Strong management and coordination skills, self-motivated, meticulous, conscientious and with good reasoning skills. Independent and able to work effectively with others in a team environment. Positive attitude, energetic, enthusiastic, possess good communication and interpersonal skills and passionate about animals. Competent in Microsoft Office Applications. Office Location : The office will be situated at: Animal Management Centre 57 Sungei Tengah Road Singapore 699013 Only shortlisted candidates will be notified. Successful candidates will be offered an 11-month employment contract.
description: The Animal & Veterinary Service (AVS), a cluster of NParks, safeguards the health and welfare of animals through comprehensive and integrated programmes and works closely with partners in the veterinary and animal-related industries to strengthen capacities and enhance competencies in animal health and welfare. It is the main touch-point on animal and veterinary matters in Singapore and the first responder for all animal-related feedback. It also conducts public education and engagement programmes to foster a humane and gracious society for all, where pet owners, communities, and animals co-exist in greater harmony within our City in Nature.

responsibilities: The temporary staff member will collaborate closely with the Team Lead and key stakeholders to deliver essential planning, implementation, and operational support for scaling SportCares' specialised programmes. These include the Morning Exercise and Gym-in-a-Bag initiatives, designed to reach vulnerable seniors living in rental housing effectively, educing social isolation and enhancing their well-being in line a with the organisation’s mission to uplift underserved communities through sport. Job Responsibilities: • Support the team in designing, implementing, monitoring & evaluation of Morning Exercise programme and other initiatives to impact the lives of isolated seniors living in rental blocks. • Build and maintain strategic partnerships with new/existing stakeholders across relevant sectors to expand programme outreach. • Develop comprehensive indicators and measurement frameworks to assess programme effectiveness and provide evidence-based reporting on outcomes. • Oversee programme procurement activities within approved budgets and timelines, ensuring compliance with government procurement guidelines. • Evaluate suppliers and service providers, manage vendor relationships and performance, and ensure procurement processes meet regulatory standards. • Work closely with internal teams including Finance and Procurement to ensure funding availability and maintain prudent procurement practices.
requirements: We are looking for self-motivated individuals who value integrity, teamwork and take pride in going the extra mile to provide excellent service to stakeholders and the community. This individual should be a sport advocate through living an active lifestyle and staying active. In addition, an ideal candidate should possess the following: • Tertiary Education in a relevant field such as Sport Science & Management / Social Work / Sociology is advantageous. • Minimum 2 years’ experience in organizing and implementing programmes and outreach (not necessary sports related) to vulnerable children & youth, families, persons with disabilities, and/or seniors. • Experience in programme design, monitoring & evaluation. • An understanding of Singapore sporting ecosystem. • Experience working in the social service sector is advantageous. • Strong interpersonal skills. • Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to engage diverse stakeholders effectively. • Strong organisational, project management, and administrative capabilities with attention to detail.
description: At Sport Singapore, we aspire to transform the nation through an active lifestyle designed around innovative, fun, and meaningful sporting experiences. Sport has the unique ability to bring people together through play, regardless of age, gender, race, ability, or social status. It imparts life values, nurtures character and builds resilience. It inspires and evokes the Singapore spirit through shared experiences and strengthens our national identity. We help Singaporeans Live Better Through Sport. Sport Singapore is constantly on the lookout for individuals who are passionate about what they do. Anchored in our values of Passion for Sport, Strength through Teamwork and Care for People, we believe in working and playing, not just as a team, but as a family. The level of offer will commensurate with applicants’ experience and track records. Successful candidates will be offered a 12-months Full-time contract. Only shortlisted applicants will be notified.

responsibilities: As a Records Management and Procurement Records Management and Procurement Senior Assistant Executive/ Executive, you’ll play a vital role as a member in the Corporate Development Division ensuring the effective management of Ministry of Transport (MOT)’s records, information, procurement, compliance, and governance. Responsibilities include and not limited to: (Strategic Management) Being part of a dynamic team that leads both MOT’s records management and procurement strategy, including reviewing taxonomy and metadata structures to ensure effective organization and retrieval of information. Ensuring the Transparency, Open and Fair competition and Value for Money for Government procurement. (Systems Oversight) Manage MOT’s records management systems, ensuring they are up-to-date, user-friendly, and compliant with regulations. (Collaboration) Liaise with the National Archives of Singapore and internal divisions to facilitate records appraisal, transfer, disposition, and declassification processes. (Performance Evaluation) Analyse filing activities and assess the effectiveness of MOT’s record management systems, recommending improvements as needed. (Staff Training) Plan and coordinate data strategy initiatives and sharing sessions to educate MOT staff on records management, procurement requirements and processes, promoting a culture of compliance and efficiency. (Digitisation Projects) Systematically pack and organise files whilst creating accurate metadata to ensure proper records classification, long-term preservation, and efficient accessibility of organisational information. (Administrative Support) Manage day-to-day administrative operations, ensuring timely processing and compliance with guidelines. (Procurement) Oversee the Ministry’s procurement operations, including reviewing proposals and requirement specifications, providing guidance on policies and processes, and managing quotation and tender exercises via GeBIZ. (Communication) Develop and produce collateral to support publicity and internal communication efforts related to records management and procurement initiatives. (Ad Hoc Tasks) Undertake any other duties as assigned by the Division Director or Section Head, contributing to the overall effectiveness of Ministry of Transport’s Corporate Development Division.
requirements: The officer should be a Singapore citizen with some relevant working experience. The officer should possess good interpersonal, organisational, written and communication skills. responsibilities: As Manager, Bus Procurement , you will play a key role in shaping Singapore's next-generation public bus fleet. By 2030, we will be replacing half of our 6,000-strong bus fleet with cutting-edge electric vehicles, and this role puts you in the forefront of this historic transition. Working at the intersection of engineering, policy, and sustainability, you will lead strategic bus procurement initiatives that directly influence fleet performance, passenger experience, and long-term asset resilience. Your work will take you beyond Singapore's borders as you scout emerging technologies and collaborate with global manufacturers to bring the most advanced solutions to our streets. You'll witness firsthand the latest innovations in electric propulsion, autonomous systems, and smart connectivity as you help modernise a fleet that's not just safe and reliable, but also future-ready. As the Manager, Bus Procurement , you will drive diverse and impactful responsibilities encompassing comprehensive end-to-end bus procurement and strategic asset management, including: 1. Drive Fleet Renewal and Replacement : Lead the charge in developing and executing strategies to renew and replace fleet to meet operational, safety, and sustainability objectives across the public bus network. 2. Tender Specifications & Evaluation : Lead in drafting new buses requirements, preparing tender specifications, and evaluating submissions to ensure the best value for the fleet. 3. Quality Assurance : Conduct pre-delivery inspections and testing of bus equipment to ensure they comply with contract specifications and operational standards. 4. Collaborate with Cross-Functional Teams : Coordinate with internal stakeholders (operations, engineering, policy, and system teams) to ensure seamless integration of bus systems and technologies onto the bus platform. 5. Partnership Management : Build and nurture strong relationships with overseas bus manufacturers and suppliers, staying informed on industry innovations and product developments. 6. Market Research & Design Specifications : Conduct in-depth research into emerging bus technologies and trends, making recommendations for design requirement to inform design improvements and future tender specifications. 7. Procurement Budget Oversight : Ensure cost-effective purchasing while maintaining high standards of quality, all within the boundaries of the procurement budget. Your work will directly support the advancement of Singapore's public bus fleet, enhance operational excellence and sustainability outcomes, and contribute to maintaining Singapore's position as a global leader in innovative and future-ready public transport solutions.
requirements: We are seeking someone who has a passion for public transport and asset management. The ideal candidate will possess: Knowledge in Engineering (Electrical, Electrical & Electronic, Mechanical, Automotive or equivalent). Experience : At least 7 years of relevant experience in automotive, engineering, or related industries. Familiarity with battery systems, service, and maintenance of bus will be advantageous. Skills : Strong analytical, planning, and problem-solving abilities with attention to detail. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, alongside proficiency in IT. Attributes : A proactive, self-motivated individual with the ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities effectively. As part of the shortlisting process for the role, you may be required to complete a medical declaration and / or undergo further assessment.

description: MAS' IT Department seeks an experienced professional with expertise in SWIFT-related domain knowledge, including standards, payments and securities, combined with strong technical knowledge in payment systems and SWIFT solution design capabilities.

You will review SWIFT infrastructure architecture blueprints in collaboration with MAS internal cross-functional IT and operations teams to ensure architectural designs fulfil all requirements. You will also design and manage scalable SWIFT solutions that align with MAS's technology standards and integration requirements. As the designated Point-of-Contact for SWIFT technical teams, you will review and guide SWIFT Alliance implementation planning whilst coordinating with MAS internal teams to ensure resource availability. As part of the team, you will handle: SWIFT Solution Design: Evaluate SWIFT technology options review and validate SWIFT product architectures to ensure alignment with MAS technology standards and security requirements product that support current and future business requirements Create technical designs for SWIFT message flows, system integrations, and connectivity patterns between SWIFT Product with MEPS+ and MAS back-office platforms and applications Technical Implementation & Operations: Identify and coordinate with business process owners and third-party SWIFT teams to oversee business process modelling. Implement, configure, upgrade, enhance and optimise SWIFT Alliance Product, and related infrastructure components for maximum efficiency (e.g. routing rules, access control). Provide subject matter expertise as required should contentions arise on the technical requirements during the design phase between the third party and MAS and provide necessary arbitration to achieve a common goal Manage daily operational tasks including exception handling, and system health checks (e.g monitoring message flow, system performance metrics, vulnerability management) Troubleshoot complex SWIFT connectivity issues, message processing errors, and performance bottlenecks to ensure minimal service disruption. Implement and maintain SWIFT Customer Security Programme (CSP) requirements and all mandatory security controls. Procurement & Vendor Management: Lead procurement initiatives for SWIFT solutions, including preparation of comprehensive technical specifications, and evaluation of vendor proposals Oversee vendor performance management and ensure compliance with contractual obligations and service level agreements
requirements: Experience and Technical skill set required: Good Degree with at least 5 years' relevant experience in financial services, with demonstrated experience in both hands-on SWIFT implementation . Extensive experience with back-office business operations or back-office system integration knowledge Strong understanding of SWIFT-IBM MQ integration Strong technical background, with good understanding of SWIFT’s products, services and applications, including SWIFT PKI, SWIFT Alliance Gateway, SWIFT Alliance Access, SWIFT WebAccess, SWIFTNet, FIN/MX ISO20022 messaging formats Good understanding of SWIFT’s Customer Security Program (CSP) and the proposed controls by SWIFT Experience in designing SWIFT technical solutions, integration patterns, and system connectivity architectures Strong understanding of API design, messaging patterns, and system integration methodologies Familiar with IT Infrastructure Technology Stack in a medium to large-scale implementation Experience and Technical Skillset which would be an advantage: Understanding of financial instruments, payment and security settlement flow Proven experience in vendor management and procurement processes, including technical specification development Proven experience in process re-engineering and automation Soft Skills: Able to work independently as well as in a team Ability to work with details and time-sensitive issues. Strong interpersonal communication and organizing skills to coordinate and faciliate project activities and discussions. Ability to work with minimal supervision and adapt to a rapidly changing environment. This is a 2-Year contract position. As part of the shortlisting process for this role, you may be required to complete a medical declaration and/or undergo further assessment. All applicants will be notified on whether they are shortlisted or not within 4 weeks of the closing date of this job posting.

pcfCompetencies: Sourcing and tendering; Contract management; Supplier and vendor management
responsibilities: Operational Delivery & Application Portfolio Management Own operational delivery outcomes for the MEPS+ application portfolio across interbank payments, government securities management, and domestic market infrastructures. Make and recommend strategic decisions on application rationalisation, consolidation, or decommissioning to optimise portfolio efficiency. Coordinate release management and delivery cycles with product owners, ensuring timely and quality deployment of enhancements, patches, and security updates across major (semi-annual) and monthly patch cycles. Own Service Level Objectives (SLOs) for applications under management. Review SLI and SLO performance reports produced by the SRE team, identify trends and deviations, and escalate or drive remediation as appropriate. Set requirements for monitoring coverage and alert quality; hold the SRE team accountable for outcomes. Coordinate verification of monthly and quarterly system patching with the SRE team. Ensure patch outcomes are documented and meet compliance requirements. Tech Delivery Manager Responsibilities (During Release Cycles) Lead release planning and delivery activities during major enhancement releases (semi-annual). Coordinate with product owners, development teams, testing teams, and vendors to establish release scope, timelines, and deployment readiness criteria. Manage release communication to all stakeholders. Provide status updates, escalate blockers, and maintain stakeholder alignment on release objectives and timelines throughout the cycle. Own release governance and quality standards for MEPS+. Define the release readiness criteria and test governance framework that the Software Engineer executes against. Review and sign off on test outcomes, patch verification results, and release readiness reports before production deployment. Incident Management Own the incident management framework for MEPS+. Define and maintain incident escalation paths, SLO targets (P1, P2, P3), and communication protocols. During major incidents, lead stakeholder communication and coordinate the response — software engineers provide technical investigation and resolution support. Drive root cause analysis and post-mortems following significant incidents. Own the documentation of lessons learned and track implementation of preventive measures to reduce recurrence. Vendor Coordination & Procurement Own vendor governance for outsourced components and services. Chair vendor performance reviews, monitor SLA compliance, and make escalation decisions when vendor performance falls short. Coordinate with software engineers for detailed technical review of vendor-delivered code and fixes. Lead MAS's participation in procurement activities for outsourced services, including defining tender specifications, evaluating vendor proposals, and contributing to contract negotiations. Compliance, Governance & Risk Management Coordinate RFI responses across the team, ensuring accurate and timely submission of supporting documentation. Plan and lead resiliency exercises including Disaster Recovery drills, manual contingency procedures, and CyberEx participation. Validate system failover and recovery capabilities. Maintain compliance with ICT Governance policies and standards specific to government financial infrastructure.
requirements: Essential Criteria 8+ years of progressive experience in managing, operating, or delivering complex mission-critical systems. Minimum 3–4 years in a delivery management, operations management, or technical programme management role with clear accountability for system reliability or release outcomes. Experience with payment systems, securities settlement, or financial infrastructure is advantageous but not required. Demonstrated ability to lead incident response at an organisational level — owning stakeholder communication, driving post-mortems, and implementing systemic improvements. Track record of managing high-stakes operational environments. Proven experience managing vendor relationships, chairing performance reviews, and holding vendors accountable to SLAs. Experience contributing to procurement or contract management activities. Strong experience coordinating release cycles across multiple teams — development, testing, operations, and compliance — with accountability for release readiness decisions. Excellent communication skills. Able to explain technical risks, operational decisions, and compliance requirements clearly to senior leadership, business stakeholders, and regulators. Strong written communication for incident reports, post-mortems, audit RFI responses, and governance documentation. Comfortable working across technical domains without requiring deep hands-on expertise in every platform. Able to engage credibly with software engineers and SRE colleagues, ask the right questions, and make informed decisions based on their input. Proven ability to manage multiple concurrent workstreams — incident response, release coordination, compliance activities, vendor management — without losing attention to detail or governance rigour. Desirable Criteria Familiarity with Java/J2EE application environments, Linux/RHEL systems, or SQL — sufficient to engage meaningfully with engineering teams and understand technical risk, without necessarily being a hands-on practitioner. Experience with containerisation technologies (Docker, Kubernetes) or cloud platforms (OpenShift, OpenStack) at a conceptual or governance level. Experience with CICD pipelines, release automation, and test management frameworks. Familiarity with observability and monitoring platforms (e.g. Grafana, ELK stack) from an operational governance perspective. Familiarity with government IT environments and regulatory compliance frameworks (CCoP, CSP, AGO, IM8). Agile delivery experience and comfort collaborating with product teams and development teams. Relevant certifications (e.g. ITIL, PMP, AWS Solutions Architect, or equivalent).
description: The Monetary Authority of Singapore (MAS) is Singapore's central bank and integrated financial regulator. MEPS+ (Central Banking & Devt Platforms Division) is responsible for the MAS Electronic Payment System — a mission-critical system supporting interbank payments, government securities management, and domestic market infrastructure. MEPS+ serves the entire Singapore financial sector and requires 24/7 operational reliability, strict compliance with government regulatory frameworks, and close coordination with financial institutions and government agencies. As System Manager, you are the operational and delivery owner for MEPS+ and related systems. You own the outcomes, and coordinate across software engineers, product owners, compliance teams, and external vendors to ensure system reliability, regulatory compliance, and successful delivery of enhancements and patches.

responsibilities: As part of the Strategy & Planning team under IED, you will support the team’s strategic planning function to chart out and review Enterprise Singapore’s strategies for developing Singapore’s innovation and startup ecosystem, and grow more innovative enterprises. You will also support the team’s programmes and policy initiatives that help our local enterprises and deep tech startups innovate, develop new products for commercialisation, and scale. You will work closely with both public and private sector partners, as well as internal stakeholders, to grow the enterprises and ecosystem, and ensure alignment with Whole-of-Government (WOG) I&E strategies, including the Research, Innovation & Enterprise 2030 (RIE2030) plans. Your responsibilities will include: Developing and reviewing strategies to grow Singapore’s innovation and startup ecosystem, and support more enterprises in their innovation journeys; Developing and reviewing specific I&E programmes to evaluate their impact and ensure continued relevance, working closely with other agencies within the I&E ecosystem; Supporting the Innovation Group’s corporate planning functions; Other cross-division/group workstreams supporting enterprise growth.

Independence and initiative: Self-motivated professional who thrives in ambiguous environments and can drive projects to milestones. Clarity in communication: Outstanding writing and communication skills. Collaborative spirit: Strong interpersonal skills and ability to work across teams and organisations. Preferred Background: Keen interest in Singapore's innovation and enterprise landscape. Experience in strategy development, policy analysis, or ecosystem development. All academic disciplines welcome

(b) Involve in preparing and conducting training, and providing user guides relating to procurement and revenue contracting matters. (d) Perform procurement and revenue contacting operations (including the review the procurement / revenue contracting submissions). Others You will also need to perform other ad-hoc matters, e.g. secretariat for key meetings or be part of the Finance transformation team.

responsibilities: Procurement Transformation & Strategy (a) Undertake review of internal procurement and revenue contracting policies and develop appropriate approaches, based on best practices, to achieve effective and efficient procurement and revenue contracting strategies. (b) Lead and support the transformation of the Ministry’s procurement and revenue contracting processes, policies and systems. This includes using data driven analytics to support the areas of transformation and coming up with frameworks to balance efficiency and governance/controls. (c) Drive the adoption of digital procurement tools, software, platforms and any available central IT solutions to improve the procurement and revenue contracting processes and data collection. (d) Change management preparation for onboard of any new system or revised work processes, e.g., engage relevant stakeholder, prepare training brief and user guides. Procurement Operations & Policy (a) Pro-actively engage and provide professional procurement and revenue contracting advice to divisions to ensure compliance with policies and processes. (b) Involve in preparing and conducting training, and providing user guides relating to procurement and revenue contracting matters. (c) Perform procurement or revenue contracting analytics for management updates, audit requirements and/or improvement on operations. (d) Perform procurement and revenue contacting operations (including the review the procurement / revenue contracting submissions). Others You will also need to perform other ad-hoc matters, e.g. secretariat for key meetings or be part of the Finance transformation team.
requirements: Functional Skills (a) Good understanding of Public Sector finance (from budget to pay), procurement and/or revenue contracting knowledge would be an advantage (b) Prior working experience in public agencies would be an added advantage (c) Meticulous and sensitive to figures and data (d) Ability to translate & operationalise policy changes introduced by Central Agencies Qualifications & Others (a) Degree in Accountancy, Business Administration or equivalent (b) Confident communicator with good writing and presentation skills (c) Positive attitude and self-motivated (d) Good interpersonal skills and is able to communicate requirement clearly with the relevant stakeholders, able to work independently and as a team
description: You will be part of MND’s Finance team and play an important role in providing procurement and revenue contracting advisory, and support to HQ Divisions within the Ministry. You will also be required to liaise with MND’s Statutory Boards and Central Agencies on procurement and revenue contracting related matters.

responsibilities: 1. ICT Project Management • Lead end to end project planning, execution, monitoring, and delivery of ICT and digitalisation initiatives. • Develop project and programme strategies that align with GRA’s Digitalisation Plan and organisation mission. • Establish and maintain appropriate project governance structure, including steering / working committees and decision-making mechanisms / processes to ensure timely delivery. • Drive the adoption of project management methodologies, tools and framework to enhance delivery outcome • Manage project risks, issues, dependencies, and change requests with timely and proper documentation and escalation. • Track and analyse project performance, prepare progress reports, and ensure alignment with GRA’s strategic programmes. 2. ICT Governance & Compliance • Ensure all ICT projects comply to WOG / GRA’s ICT governance frameworks and policies, IT security standards, data privacy / protection and risk management requirements. • Partner with the ICT governance team to incorporate required controls into project design, implementation, and operations. • Lead audit exercises, internal/external reviews and quality assurance checks for compliance with data privacy / protection, security, procurement and IM policies. 3. Support GRA’s Digitalisation Strategy • Contribute to the development, implementation and continuous improvement of GRA’s digitalisation strategy and roadmap. • Identify opportunities for process optimisation, automation, and adoption of innovative technologies to enhance organisation efficiency. • Support performance monitoring and reporting of digitalisation KPIs and project outcome. • Surface gaps, risk and improvement areas to strengthen digital capability and technology governance. 4. Stakeholder & Vendor Management • Serve as the primary liaison with business users and management to ensure alignment and buy-in for digital initiatives. • Gather and translate user requirements into clear project scopes and deliverables. • Manage vendor relationships, including procurement activities, contract administration and performance evaluation. • Facilitate workshops, briefings, and communication sessions to ensure stakeholders alignment and readiness for deployment of new system. • Drive change management efforts to support smooth adoption of new systems, processes and technologies.
requirements: • Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics Engineering, or a related discipline. • Minimum 3 – 5 years of relevant experience in ICT project management or IT consulting, preferably in digitalisation projects. • Strong understanding of ICT governance, risk management, security and data privacy / protection best practices. • Demonstrated experience in managing multiple projects and stakeholders in a fast paced environment. • Analytical, proactive and able to navigate challenges with creatively and sound judgement. • Strong communication, presentation, and negotiation skills, with the ability to engage stakeholders at all levels • Experience with government ICT projects or ISO9001 aligned project management practices is an advantage. • Professional certifications such as PMP, PRINCE2, CITPM, Scrum Master, COMIT will be an advantage.
description: The Project Manager (ICT Projects) is responsible for planning, leading, and delivering ICT and digitalisation initiatives that support GRA’s strategic objectives. The role ensures that projects comply with WOG/GRA ICT governance frameworks, security and data privacy / protection requirements, and established project management standards. The Project Manager will work closely with internal stakeholders and external partners to drive project success from initiation to implementation, including risk, change management and benefits realisation.

responsibilities: Responsibilities: • Be a member in the OM team for the day-to-day operations and management of office building, facilities, security, projects and office space planning in AGC. • Oversees and manage the Integrated Facilities Management (IFM) vendor and administration of the contract to ensure maintenance of the office premises is efficiently managed and in accordance to contract requirements. • Ensures vendors meet the contractual obligations and goods/ services are delivered in accordance with the service agreements. • Manages current processes and systems and to develop and execute improvement plans to enhance operations and internal stakeholder satisfaction and engagement. • Oversees the management of office equipment and furniture, maintenance of Mechanical and Electrical services/ systems, Fire protection system, VOIP systems, AVVC system and facilities operations with the in-house IFM, including service requests, and fault reporting. • Oversees the testing and maintenance of the Fire Alarm System, Fire Protection System and PA System, including comms to affected officers. • Management of public utilities and telecommunications usage including verifying and monitoring payment. • Oversees the management/ stock take of AGC fixed assets and inventories and Records Management filing in accordance with relevant guidelines. • Prepares AOR papers, ITQ/ ITT specifications, calling, evaluating and award of tenders for contracts and putting up approval papers for the procurement of items/ contracts under the portfolio. • Provides support in other portfolio such as projects management, events/logistics management, workplace safety and health, emergency preparedness and inventory stock management (where required). • Performs any other duties assigned by the Operations Department.

responsibilities: The key role of the Innovation & Research Translation (IRT) directorate is to build a vibrant Innovation & Enterprise (I&E) ecosystem that enables deep tech innovations from our universities and A*STAR to be translated into globally competitive products, services and businesses. You will lead a team that will advance the following objectives: • Identify emerging deep tech areas with potential for large economic growth in the future, through a deep understanding of our local peaks of excellence, global developments, and market opportunities; • Validate the thesis on the economic potential for these areas through: (1) a data-centric approach, (2) qualitative understanding of the R&D and innovation landscape, and (3) engagements with Key Opinion Leaders and industry experts; • Work with Economic Agencies to develop sector-specific strategies and tools to grow a critical mass of companies in the emerging deep tech areas; • Work with deep tech ecosystem partners and multipliers, such as Venture Builders, Incubators, Tech Transfer Offices etc to provide a comprehensive suite of support that enables innovation in the emerging deep tech areas; • Monitor the overall I&E ecosystem to identify gaps in deep tech commercialisation, particularly at the early stages of research translation; and • Manage relevant funding schemes that are administered by NRF in support of our efforts to grow the deep tech and I&E ecosystem.
requirements: Background in science, engineering, economics or public policy; • At least 5 years of relevant working experience preferably working on tech policy or driving innovation in a technology startup or company; • Strong analytical abilities with a broad sense of perspective; • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; • Ability to forge strong relationships and networks with ecosystem partners; and • Ability to collaborate well with others

responsibilities: Reporting to the Senior Manager, you will lead a team of executives and service contractors for the management of buildings/facilities maintenance to support Authority's operations across multiple premises. As owner of all related systems, you will be responsible for site inspections, cost analysis, budgeting, preparing work quotations/tender specifications, procurement of services, attending to feedback and ad-hoc decisions. You will constantly review work processes and procedures to enhance facilities operations, adopt good industry practices, and ensure compliance with government regulations. Your roles include: Integrated Facilities Management: Oversee facilities management operations including housekeeping with oversight of security operations across HQ and satellite offices through our IFMS Operations Command Centre (OCC). Technical Systems Management: Monitor and maintain all electrical and mechanical systems including chilled water systems, VRV and DX systems, High-Tension and Low-Tension electrical systems. Perform data analysis on real-time data from IoT sensors, OCC dashboards, and smart energy meters. Prepare/present monthly progress of Smart FM and utilities utilisation reports to Senior Management. Sustainability & Energy Management: Identify utilities wastage, monitor waste management, recommend improvements, and develop policies for Smart FM and energy management to meet WOG and Authority’s Green Plan targets, including reporting efforts. Innovation & Smart Technologies:Manage implementation of new initiatives including smart FM technologies, sensors and IoT devices. Manage customer service-oriented support services including concierge services and logistic support for offices and events. Contract & Vendor Management: Review, manage and supervise term contracts to ensure performance, meeting KPIs/SLAs, compliance, and timely renewals across all premises. Ensure day to day safe, effective, smooth, uninterrupted operations of LTA’s premises with quality service levels and timely closure of all maintenance and logistics requests, feedbacks. To ensure high availability of all equipment/systems/services/premises. Compliance & Safety: Ensure regulatory compliance, safety standards, and uninterrupted operations at all facilities. Manage emergency operations and other duties as assigned to meet organisational objectives, including specifications review/input for new build/improvement projects concerning facility management and operations. Relocation Management: Manage phased transition of existing offices and taking over new offices and manage reinstatement and return of existing premises to landlords.
requirements: Tertiary qualification in facilities management/engineering with at least 8 years of relevant experience (strong ACMV/mechanical background essential). Experience in commercial office environments and large-scale facility management. Experience in data analytics for smart FM technologies and building maintenance. Proven leadership skills with successful track record in service delivery. Technically sound with knowledge of M&E maintenance, vendor management, and building regulation compliance. Certified BCA Energy Auditors, Singapore Certified Energy Managers have added advantage. Able to work weekends and after hours when required. As part of the shortlisting process for the role, you may be required to complete a medical declaration and / or undergo further assessment

responsibilities: Perform food radioactivity testing and all related functions to support SFA food safety monitoring and surveillance programs. Expand the testing capability of the Food Radioactivity Specialist Team to cover all the relevant radionuclides specified in the Codex Alimentarius General Standard for Contaminants and Toxins in Food and Feed, which entails method establishment and method validation for the achievement of method accreditation by the Singapore Accreditation Council for alpha, beta and gamma emitting radionuclides. Implement laboratory quality assurance programs to ensure that the laboratory practices are in full compliance with ISO/IEC 17025:2017 standards. Prepare method and equipment SOPs and quality documents used by the Team. Conduct method validation for test methods and prepare method validation and measurement uncertainty reports. Prepare weekly and monthly reports to update management on significant test findings and provide risk assessments and recommendations where necessary to support SFA's standard setting and policymaking in food radioactivity regulatory control. Procurement of lab supplies and equipment to support the operations of the lab. Participate in collaboration projects with National and International partners on developing and enhancing testing capabilities for supporting the pertinent natural and artificial radionuclides surveillance programs. Deliver presentations on specialized areas and prepare manuscripts for scientific publications. Conduct training and organize proficiency testing programs for ASEAN participants as well as commercial laboratories to upgrade radionuclides testing capability in Singapore and ASEAN region.
requirements: Requirements The candidate should have a BSc, MSc or PhD in Chemistry, Radiochemistry, or other related scientific fields. Good knowledge and hand-on experience in sample extraction, cleanup and detection of foodborne chemical or radiochemical hazards will be an advantage. Prior experiences with radioanalytical instruments (alpha spectrometer, liquid scintillation counter, gamma spectrometer) and Inductively Coupled Plasma Mass Spectrometer will be an advantage. Prior experiences in implementing ISO/IEC 17025:2017 laboratory quality. Self-motivated, proactive, and resourceful. Able to work independently, and in a team. Organized and able to multitask. Strong written and communication skills. Proficient in MS Office applications (Word, Excel, Power Point etc.). Work Location National Centre for Food Science, 7 International Business Park, Singapore 609919.
description: The mission of SFA is to ensure and secure a supply of safe food for Singapore. The National Centre for Food Science (NCFS) supports SFA’s vision of ensuring safe food for all by being a national reference laboratory on food science, conducting food safety monitoring to generate scientific data for enforcement of food regulations, support of risk assessment and protection of consumer health. NCFS oversees the application of science and technology to enable an evidence-based approach for ensuring food safety in partnership with stakeholders across the entire food chain and research institutions to address emerging food safety and security concerns. You will be part of a dynamic team of the Food Safety Rapid Response Department (FSRRD) under NCFS to provide support to SFA’s food safety regulatory testing and market monitoring programs. This is a fantastic opportunity for you to learn and apply a wide range of cutting-edge testing and diagnostic techniques to solve real world problems and safeguard the food safety for Singaporeans. The Specialist Teams under FSRRD strive to continue developing our scientific knowledge and testing capabilities to keep pace with the challenges of emerging foodborne chemical, radiochemical and biological hazards. We collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to enhance food safety standards in the region, and support food security initiatives such as high-tech farming and novel food innovation. You will be deployed to the Food Radioactivity Specialist Team under FSRRD, playing a key role in developing new analytical methods for strengthening and broadening the testing capabilities and for enabling risk assessment to support SFA’s operation needs for food safety regulatory function and market monitoring programs. Based on the operation needs of the Department and your career advancement path, there are ample job rotation opportunities to broaden your scientific knowledge and sharpen your professional skills.

Centralised Product Development & Innovation • Generate creative and innovative ideas and concepts for new products that address identified operational needs and market opportunities. • Define comprehensive roadmaps based on vision and product specifications, including detailed design parameters, feature requirements, and performance criteria. • Create prototypes and conduct testing to validate product designs, test hypotheses, and verify functionalities. • Analyse resulting data to inform product refinements and improvements. • Experiment with emerging ICT solutions and tools, systematically evaluating their effectiveness and potential for organisational implementation. • Manage the procurement of required software, systems, and services essential for product development initiatives. • Evaluate and actively manage project risks encompassing timeliness, budget constraints, quality standards, and compatibility with HDB's operational environment. • Facilitate seamless handover of pilot deployments to operations departments, ensuring smooth integration and successful expansion. • Execute comprehensive procurement activities in accordance with established guidelines and best practices. Innovation & Technology Piloting • Develop pilot projects that showcase cross-departmental synergies and integration opportunities. • Pilot emerging technologies (AI, automation) to assess their suitability for HDB operations. • Evaluate vendor solutions and platforms through controlled pilot environments. • Test integration capabilities with existing HDB systems and processes. • Coordinate bottom-up technology idea formulation and innovation framework development. • Network with GovTech and industry players for Proof-of-Concept (POC) projects and collaborative initiatives. Digital Capability Development & Change Management • Work with stakeholders across the Group to improve digital literacy and skills through targeted training programmes and capability-building initiatives. • Develop and implement strategies to enhance digital competency levels across Group. • Facilitate knowledge transfer and best practice sharing to build organisational digital capabilities. • Support change management initiatives to drive digital adoption and transformation across the Group. • Implement effective change management strategies to ensure successful project adoption across the Group. • Use pilot projects as change management tools to demonstrate benefits and build user confidence. • Create success stories and case studies to support broader digital transformation initiatives. • Collaborate with stakeholders on culture building and competency development. System Maintenance & Support • Take responsibility for deployed centralised system design and functionalities, ensuring optimum performance and reliability across all platforms. • Perform routine and corrective maintenance activities, including software enhancements, bug fixes, comprehensive testing, and system commissioning. • Conduct detailed analyses on system functionalities to identify improvement opportunities and operational efficiencies. • Gather and address user feedback systematically, identify operational challenges and gaps in centralised systems, and implement targeted improvements. • Collaborate with departmental System Administrators to harness synergistic opportunities and expedite enhancement implementation. • Evaluate, prioritise, and manage enhancement lists to ensure strategic alignment and resource optimisation. Quality Assurance & User Experience • Conduct comprehensive user testing and monitor post-launch product performance metrics. • Gather structured user feedback and implement data-driven enhancements to improve user satisfaction. • Manage all centralised product documentation including technical specifications, user manuals, and change management collaterals. • Maintain and regularly update product documentation to reflect current system capabilities and procedural changes.
