description: Description of Group Looking for a workplace with passion and commitment to empower and restore lives of the vulnerable population in Singapore? Join the Rehabilitation and Protection Group (RPG)! Description of Division/Branch RPG provides statutory intervention and leads in child protection and adult protection policies and processes to safeguard Children and Young Persons (CYPs) as well as Vulnerable Adults (VAs) in Singapore. The science and art of our work remain very much firmly rooted in keeping vulnerable persons safe from harm, working in partnership with families and stakeholders such as the schools, hospitals and other community partners. The Performance and Vendor Management (PVM) unit plays a pivotal role in enhancing client safety and optimising manpower resources through the strategic outsourcing of operational functions to vendors. Your role will primarily focus on overseeing vendor services which are critical in ensuring the safety, well-being and continuity of care for PSV clients. In this role, you will maintain oversight of vendors, working closely with them to ensure effective service delivery and compliance with practice standards. As a member of the PVM team, you will also collaborate with internal stakeholders such as Operations, Service Planning, and Procurement teams to identify opportunities and align vendor services with PSV’s business needs across various functions. You will contribute to risk mitigation efforts and support the division in achieving optimal value from vendor partnerships. This role will also provide you with valuable exposure to different areas within vendor management, offering opportunities for professional development and cross-functional learning.

description: The Asian Civilisations Museum is the only museum in the region devoted to exploring the rich artistic heritage of Asia, especially the ancestral cultures of Singaporeans. Opened in 1997 and in its present building by the Singapore River since 2003, the museum traces its roots to the Raffles Museum, founded in the middle of 19th century. ACM focuses on the many historical and artistic connections between the cultures of Asia, and between Asia and the world. Singapore’s history as a port city that brought people together from all over the world is used as a means of examining the history of Asia. Objects on display tell stories of the trade and the exchange of ideas that were the result of international commerce, as well as the flow of religions and faith through Asia. Asian Civilisation Museum manages the Peranakan Museum. The Peranakan Museum (TPM) explores the art and culture of Peranakan communities in Southeast Asia and possesses one of the finest and most comprehensive collections of Peranakan objects. Galleries on three floors illustrate the cultural traditions and distinctive visual arts of Peranakans. In this role, you will contribute to the delivery of inspiring and engaging museum experiences by planning and managing exhibitions, gallery displays, museum rotation projects and gallery maintenance for the Asian Civilisations Museum / Peranakan Museum. You will handle artefacts and work out the best way to display them with fellow passionate museum professionals.

agency: Home Team Science and Technology Agency (HTX)
responsibilities: Strategic AI Masterplanning • Drive the strategic AI masterplan across AI domains in HTX, aligning it with MHA strategic objectives and Home Team operational needs. • Act as the central planning hub for all AI initiatives, including the review of scope, timeline and budget before approval. • Conduct strategic foresighting and scenario planning to identify emerging technology opportunities across the AI domains. Programme Management • Lead AI programmes delivery, budgeting and resource allocation; produce regular dashboards and reports on AI adoption, performance and organisational AI maturity. • Coordinate with cross-functional teams to ensure timely delivery of AI projects and initiatives. • Provide technical expertise for the procurement of AI solutions, including reviewing specifications and evaluating vendor proposals. AI Governance & Risk Management • Develop and continuously update the AI Governance strategy and playbook covering key principles such as explainability, fairness, privacy, security, accountability, robustness and sustainability. • Establish metrics, monitoring processes and KPIs and provide regular updates of AI governance key performance metrics to senior leadership. Ecosystem Development & Collaboration • Design and execute an engagement strategy to build a vibrant AI ecosystem of industry, academia and government partners. • Identify, evaluate and recommend technology and vendor solutions that meet Home Team’s AI use-case requirements. • Organise outreach events, workshops and presentations; track ecosystem engagement KPIs and produce regular status reports. Stakeholder & Cross-Agency Coordination • Liaise with Home Team Departments, Programme Management Centres, Whole-of-Government (WoG) agencies and statutory boards to align AI requirements, ensure interoperability and facilitate data sharing. • Collaborate across cross-functional teams (Solutioning, Certifications, R&D, Product Development, Platforms, Data Engineering, Infrastructure) to gather and consolidate AI inputs for AI masterplanning. Leadership & People Management • Supervise a team of AI specialists and foster a culture of innovation, collaboration and continuous learning. • Conduct presentations to senior management on AI masterplan roll-out , governance updates, programmes progress and ecosystem collaboration outcomes.
requirements: • Post-graduate / tertiary qualification in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, AIor related quantitative/analytical fields. • Minimum 15 years of technology development in AI-related domains, with at least 8 years in senior roles that include strategic planning, ecosystem collaboration, programme management and governance; at least 3 years delivering large-scale, multi-site AI projects. • Strong understanding of AI domains not limited to Vision AI, Embodied AI, Language AI, LLM & LMM, AI Safety & Security, and Emerging AI; experience with AI/ML, data science and analytics, and knowledge of AI Governance policies and frameworks. • Demonstrated track record of driving strategic planning cycle, formulating strategic masterplans, and driving their successful implementation with clear, quantifiable impact. • Demonstrated track record of building strategic partnerships, evaluating vendor solutions, negotiating contracts and leading collaborative AI initiatives with industry, academia and government partners. • Experience in procurement, budgeting, financial tracking and resource allocation for AI programmes. • Excellent verbal and written communication; ability to provide briefings and influence senior stakeholders across HTX and Home Team departments; strong facilitation and interpersonal skills. • Understanding of Home Team departmental business and technical requirements; familiarity with homeland-security contexts. • Good strategic foresight & innovation. • Excellent cross-agency collaboration & communication. • Comfortable to travel occasionally. All new hires are appointed on a two-year contract in the first instance and will be assessed and considered for permanent tenure over time, based on performance. As part of the shortlisting process for this role, you may be required to complete a medical declaration and/or undergo further assessment. All applicants will be updated on the status of their applications within 4 weeks upon closing of the advertisement. #LI-CW1
description: The Deputy Director will provide strategic leadership across AI masterplanning, AI governance, and AI collaboration and programme management. For masterplanning, the Deputy Director will develop a strategic masterplan for all applied AI domains (Vision AI, Embodied AI, Language AI, large language and large multimodal models, AI safety & security, and emerging technologies). For AI governance, the Deputy Director will establish robust frameworks that embeds responsible AI practices throughout HTX’s initiatives. For AI collaboration and programme management, the role will foster strategic AI collaboration with industry, academia and other government agencies, and programme manage end to end, cross functional AI projects. Together, these efforts will deliver AI solutions that support our public safety mission, improve citizen experience, and increase operational productivity.

Assistant Manager to Manager, Business Technology Partnerships
responsibilities: [What you will be working on] Key Responsibilities: 1. Lead the Singapore Tourism Accelerator (STA) a) Coordination with Innovation Vendors: Collaborate with appointed innovation vendor to ensure a seamless global sourcing and matchmaking process between tech companies and tourism industry stakeholders. Ensure that the technology solutions align with the industry’s needs and the strategic goals of STB. b) Procurement Management: Oversee procurement aspects, including budget tracking and contract management of the appointed innovation vendor. Ensure that all procurement activities comply with STB's guidelines and are executed efficiently. c) Matchmaking and Pilot Management: Lead the matchmaking process to ensure the right solutions are paired with industry stakeholders for testing. Oversee the management of pilots, ensuring that the milestones are met, timelines are adhered to, and any roadblocks are addressed. d) Demo Day Coordination: Plan and execute Demo Day to showcase the proven solutions, including managing the logistics, coordinating with participants, and ensuring impactful presentations that demonstrate the value of each proven tech solution. 2. Overall Lead for Tcube LEARN Pillar As the lead for the Tcube LEARN pillar, you will oversee Tcube’s content strategy and events, ensuring they inspire, educate, and drive digital transformation within the tourism industry. Your role will involve strategic oversight and hands-on execution of key initiatives to effectively showcase emerging tech solutions, successful pilots, and real-world applications in the tourism sector. a) Tcube Content Strategy: -Lead the development and execution of a comprehensive content strategy that highlights Tcube’s initiatives, including case studies, articles, research papers, and videos. -Collaborate with external partners (tech companies, universities, and industry experts) to produce high-quality content aligned with Tcube’s strategic goals. -Oversee the documentation and presentation of all Tcube pilot projects to clearly demonstrate their impact on the tourism industry. b) Tcube Events: -Identify and leverage relevant industry events, conferences, and forums to showcase Tcube’s work. -Lead the planning and execution of events such as panel sessions, workshops, and presentations, ensuring they align with the following objectives: ​-Inspiration: Showcase innovative technologies to inspire fresh thinking and new applications in the tourism sector. -Learning: Provide opportunities for stakeholders to build knowledge and practical tools for navigating digital transformation. -Showcase: Present successful case studies and tangible technology solutions that have positively impacted the industry. -Transformation: Promote a culture of change by equipping stakeholders with the skills necessary to drive digital transformation within their organizations. 3) Tcube Advisor for Core Tourism Industries As the Tcube Advisor for one of the Core Tourism Industries, you will play a pivotal role in shaping its technology landscape. You will provide strategic insights and recommendations to STB line units, helping them adopt and implement cutting-edge technologies to drive operational efficiency and enhance the tourism experience. a) Industry Tech Landscape Scan: -Conduct regular scans of the tech landscape in key priority areas to understand the trends and solutions that are relevant to the industry. -Stay informed on the latest technological advancements in the priority areas and ensure that these developments are incorporated into Tcube’s strategies for industry transformation. b) Identify Key Solutions and Tech Companies: -Work with tech experts to identify and evaluate tech solutions that address the pain points of core industries. -Build and maintain strong relationships with tech providers and partners to create a pipeline of solutions that can support the digital transformation of the tourism sector. c) Support Line Units on tech adoption: -Provide guidance and strategic advice to STB line units, helping them adopt and implement new technologies to improve operations, increase efficiency, and enhance visitor experiences. -Work closely with line units to ensure smooth technology integration and monitor its impact on business outcomes.
requirements: [What we are looking for] -At least 2 years experience in marketing, project management or stakeholder management -Strong project management skills, with ability to deliver multiple projects. -Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with ability to maintain relationships with potential partners and apply negotiation tactics and risk assessment in developing partnership arrangements -Good business acumen and analytical skills to think strategically and make sound judgements -Ideally to have some experience in marketing -Independent and highly motivated individual -Collaborative mindset with the ability to work in a team-oriented environment -Strong command of written and spoken English
description: [What the role is] We are looking for a proactive and results-driven individual to lead several key initiatives that support STB’s tourism innovation efforts. Tcube, or the Tourism Technology Transformation Cube, brings STB’s digital initiatives, resources and thought-leadership content onto a single platform to support our sector’s digital transformation. As the co-manager of the Singapore Tourism Accelerator (STA), you will be responsible for overseeing the accelerator’s operations, including managing the innovation vendor, the procurement process, matchmaking of stakeholders with tech companies, pilot management, and executing the Demo Day. This will involve close collaboration with industry stakeholders to ensure successful matchmaking and meaningful pilot outcomes. Additionally, you will take the lead in driving the Tcube LEARN pillar, which includes curating and delivering content and events designed to inspire and educate the industry on digital transformation. In this role, you will partner with key tech companies and industry stakeholders to create thought leadership content, such as case study articles and videos. You will also be responsible for capturing and documenting the outcomes of all Tcube pilots to showcase the successful implementation of technology within the tourism sector. Beyond content creation, you will strategically assess opportunities for Tcube to engage industry stakeholders at key events and forums, driving thought leadership through panel sessions, workshops, and showcases. Success in this role means effectively driving industry engagement through impactful content and events, managing cross-functional collaborations with internal and external stakeholders, and ensuring that Tcube’s initiatives contribute to the digital transformation of the tourism sector. This position requires someone who is both strategic and operational, capable of managing multiple projects, and delivering tangible outcomes that elevate industry tech transformation.

description: Join Us at MSF for A Meaningful, People-Centric Career! At MSF, our mission is to nurture and build resilient individuals, strong families, and a caring society. We offer meaningful and impactful people-centric careers in the design and delivery of policies, services and programmes. We are an all-inclusive and family friendly workplace where career growth is prioritised through a comprehensive suite of development opportunities to help our officers succeed today as well as be future-ready. We do this through various formal and informal learning and development programmes for officers to build different competencies and gain diverse work experiences within MSF, the Public as well as the Social Service Sectors. You will be part of the Rehabilitation and Protection Group (RPG) that undertakes the statutory functions in the rehabilitation of adult and youth offenders, and the protection of children, families and vulnerable adults (VAs). Guided by our mission to prevent harm, protect and rehabilitate individuals, and strengthen families at risk, RPG strives toward its vision of transformed lives and safe, thriving families. Description of Branch: Partner and Capability Development Branch The Partner and Capability Development (PCD) Branch focuses on building the collective capabilities of staff and partner agencies. The team seeks to enhance the coordination of common services, enabling integrated management of partners, vendors and related stakeholders. Future Capability Development Section/ Sector Development Team You will be part of the Future Capability Development Section/ Sector Development Team that oversees the capability building of the Rehabilitative Service’s sector partners, namely the Social Service Agencies that deliver pre-Court Diversionary Programmes and pre-Family Guidance Order (FGO) services, Voluntary Children’s Homes (VCH) and Hostels, and Responsible Gambling providers (RG). As part of capability building efforts, the Sector Development Team also delivers trainings to support sector partners in delivering services and MSF-funded programmes to clients. We are looking for dynamic individuals who share our passion in supporting the rehabilitation of our beneficiaries and working closely with our partners.

jobTitle: Specialist (Design, Strategic & Project Mgmt) - Eco-Campus Planning & Dev Dept
responsibilities: Design Management Support in conducting feasibility studies for sustainable design and space planning, fit-out and infrastructure projects which will encompass budgeting, obtaining funding approval, design, project programming, procurement, regulatory compliance, design review and quality assurance. Work with internal and external stakeholders to identify requirements and propose conceptual design for the Campus Masterplan and Campus Rejuvenation projects and integrate them into project briefs and designs. Evaluate and recommend appropriate sustainable design and space planning solutions to meet the project objectives, requirements and budget. Review, challenge and value-add on the designs/specification/drawings submitted by consultants and contractors to achieve quality, compliance and value for money. Manage and review architecture, space planning, interior design and material proposals from consultants and contractors, and to ensure compliance to specifications and code requirements. Provide technical support for special projects and cross-functional initiatives. Strategic Planning and Project Management Provide overall strategic planning and project management support, which encompasses fund management, procurement, design development, consultancy and construction management, commissioning and project handover. Liaise and coordinate with internal and external stakeholders on project requirements and compliances. This will include remodeling of space in phases, planning and managing processes for funding approvals, consultations and clearances with authorities and government agencies, seeking approval from NYP’s management and oversight committees. Liaise and coordinate with consultants and contractors and monitor the timeliness of the deliverables for implementation of the project. Handling and managing project data and information, including organizing data for analysis and management reporting, ensuring proper documentation and filing for future records. Monitor and update project programme and progress, including dashboard development and control for management reporting. Assist in the development of a Building Information Modeling (BIM) framework and oversee the implementation. Strategic Planning and Project Management ​ Manage design and interface coordination through different project phases to ensure operational continuity. Review project schedules and ensure minimal disruption to operations. Attend consultant and site meetings with the Project Team and carry out site inspections to ensure compliance with sustainability goals, quality standards, project timeline and budget. Manage external/outsourced resources (consultants and site supervisory staff) to execute the projects. Ensure that contractors carry out work in a safe manner with the necessary risk assessments and workplace safety measures in place to manage project risks. Provide technical support to stakeholders in the resolution of technical issues when needed. Undertake any other tasks or responsibilities as required by Management in the course of work.
requirements: Qualification in Building / Architecture / Engineering with at least 6 years of relevant working experience as Space Planner, Architect or Project Manager preferably in public/developer organizations or consulting firms. Relevant experience in the planning, design and implementation of large-scale development and A&A projects with sustainability and smart building solutions, and Design for safety requirements. Working experience and knowledge of Government policies; functions and requirements of key Agencies and the regulatory framework for development projects. Strong in people management, good writing, communication and presentation skills. Detail-oriented and yet capable of macro analysis with good acumen in management and resolution of technical issues and challenges.
description: The position reports to the Lead / Senior Specialist is responsible for the planning, designing, and project management aligned with the NYP Campus Masterplan and Campus Rejuvenation projects. This includes overseeing the architectural and sustainable design, space planning and phased remodeling of campus spaces. The scope of works includes end-to-end management of the project from inception, procurement of services and works, construction, handover, to post-construction activities. You will contribute to creating an eco-friendly, innovative, and inclusive environment that enhances the overall campus experience.

responsibilities: Role Overview In this role, you will lead initiatives to integrate upstream operational systems into accurate, timely, and compliant financial records and reporting. You will work closely with finance teams, system managers, IT partners, and internal stakeholders to deliver sustainable digital finance solutions that enhance efficiency, transparency, and accountability in the use of public funds. Key Responsibilities Finance Systems Integration & Digital Enablement Actively configure, enhance, and maintain finance system capabilities, including automation, AI‑enabled insights, data integrity, end‑to‑end traceability, and long‑term solution sustainability. Collaborate with finance users, system managers, and IT partners to translate policy, operational, and reporting requirements into well‑governed system, integration, and AI-supported solutions. Proactively implement and integrate emerging digital tools such as data analytics and automation). Conduct risk assessments and design controls as foundational elements of solution development from the outset. Process Optimisation and Continuous Improvement Drive finance and procurement process transformation initiatives to reduce manual work, improve processing efficiency, and strengthen internal controls and compliance, leveraging automation and AI where appropriate. Analyse finance process flows to identify opportunities for intelligent automation, standardisation, and risk reduction. Develop and maintain clear process maps and documentation to facilitate approvals, training, change management and audit discussions. Oversee system administration duties, including user access management, periodic access reviews, and compliance with segregation‑of‑duties requirements, including controls over AI-enabled workflows. Data Stewardship Manage financial datasets with a strong focus on data accuracy, completeness, auditability, and compliance with data governance standards. Support the end‑to‑end system including requirements gathering, user acceptance testing, implementation, and post‑implementation review. Stakeholder Engagement & Change Support Engage stakeholders across finance, IT, and professional groups to align digital and AI-enabled transformation initiatives with organisational priorities and operating realities. Contribute to change management activities, including the creation of user communications, development of training materials, and provision of post‑implementation support to ensure sustainable adoption of new processes, systems and AI-supported ways of working.
requirements: Professional Experience At least 5 years of relevant experience in finance transformation, ERP implementation, finance systems integration, or product‑related roles supporting finance or procurement functions. Practical experience working within regulated, audit‑intensive, or public‑sector environments is preferred, particularly where strong governance and compliance requirements apply. Proficiency in using Microsoft 365 tools (such as workflow automation, collaboration, documentation) to support process improvement and cross‑functional projects. Functional Knowledge Sound understanding of core finance processes, particularly Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable, and their integration with upstream operational systems. Working knowledge of financial controls, segregation‑of‑duties principles, access management, and audit expectations. Familiarity with end‑to‑end system lifecycles, including requirements gathering, user acceptance testing, implementation, and post‑implementation review.

description: The Animal & Veterinary Service (AVS), a cluster of NParks, safeguards the health and welfare of animals through comprehensive and integrated programmes and works closely with partners in the veterinary and animal-related industries to strengthen capacities and enhance competencies in animal health and welfare. It is the main touch-point on animal and veterinary matters in Singapore and the first responder for all animal-related feedback. It also conducts public education and engagement programmes to foster a society, where pet owners, communities, and animals co-exist in our City in Nature. The Wildlife Management Division in Animal & Veterinary Service (AVS) Cluster manages wildlife in Singapore and engages the community on human-wildlife encounters in our City in Nature.

description: R&D plays an important role in contributing to MND’s vision of creating An Endearing Home, A Distinctive Global City for all Singaporeans. As cities around the world face increasingly complex urban sustainability challenges, R&D is essential in future proofing Singapore’s development. The R&D division in MND works closely with MND statutory boards, other government agencies, partners from the research community including IHLs, Research Institutes, and the industry to conceptualise R&D plans and drive implementation. Our research efforts are guided by Research, Innovation and Enterprise (RIE) plans which are organised along four domains - Urban Solutions and Sustainability (USS), Manufacturing, Trade and Connectivity (MTC), Human Health and Potential (HHP), Smart Nation and Digital Economy (SNDE). Of relevance to the MND Family is the Urban Solutions and Sustainability (USS) domain, where the efforts in this domain seek to “Renew and build a liveable, resilient, sustainable and economically vibrant city for tomorrow”. responsibilities: Key responsibilities include: Lead and manage the ATM support systems related projects, which include replacement of existing systems, perform enhancement works and tech refresh upgrades. Ensure the projects are delivered on time, within scope, and meet defined operational requirements. Design the system architecture and develop the technical specifications for the ATM support systems, which are being deployed both on-site and on cloud platforms. Work with users and stakeholders to formulate the operational, technical, and cybersecurity requirements. Ensure that the replacement systems, enhancements, and upgrades are implemented in accordance with these requirements. Seek approval from the relevant authorities to adopt the proposed system design and technical specifications Formulate the budget required for the projects and devise the system implementation plans. This includes Identifying and mitigating risks which may impact the successful delivery of the systems Perform procurement activities for the enhancement works and technology refresh upgrades, including evaluating proposed solutions. Implement and deploy the ATM support systems with the vendors (including testing and commissioning activities). Support the operation and maintenance activities of the ATM support systems, such as preventive and corrective maintenance. You are also required to ensure that the ATM support systems are implemented in accordance with the international standards (such as ICAO and Eurocae), as well as applicable governance regulations (such as cyber security requirements). These systems are software intensive, complex and requires high availability. You will need to work closely with multiple stakeholders (both internal and external), including other government agencies, system suppliers, maintenance operators, operation users, IT consultants etc. to ensure the system(s) meets the required standards and requirements. Stakeholder management is critical, and you are expected to coordinate and liaise with the respective stakeholders.
requirements: Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in managing, implementing and deploying information centric systems. Proficient in system architecture design and system implementation for both on-premises and cloud setups Familiar with the various cloud products and services (such as AWS and Azure) Well versed in performing testing and commissioning activities, to ensure that the desired technical specifications are met Experience in networking and cybersecurity compliance Good understanding of air traffic control related systems will be a plus point Experience in networking and cybersecurity compliance Good communication and written skills, good attention to details. Organised and good self-disciplined to meet timeline May be required to travel for overseas meeting Your appointment designation will commensurate with your relevant work experience. Successful candidates will be offered a 3-year contract in the first instance, and may be considered for placement on a permanent tenure or a contract renewal.
description: You will be part of the team overseeing the operation and maintenance of the Air Traffic Management (ATM) support systems. These systems support Air Traffic Control (ATC) and fault management operations such as flight plan processing, Notice to Airmen (NOTAM) submission, data logging and disseminating of essential safety related information. You will be involved in planning, managing and executing enhancement works and tech refresh upgrades on the ATM support systems. This involves seeking budget approval, managing the project activities, designing of the system architecture, formulating the technical specifications and coordinating with the various vendors.

description: Are you looking for a challenging career that allows you to be part of police operations in keeping Singapore safe and secure? Join us and be part of our team at the Singapore Police Force (SPF). SPF plays a critical role in keeping Singapore safe and secure with our mission to prevent, deter and detect crime. Special Operations Command (SOC) is the lead tactical arm of SPF to provide highest level of tactical option to combat crime, terrorism and public disorder. We seek to constantly explore, innovate and adapt cutting-edge technology to support our officers to enhance policing efforts for crime fighting. As a Logistics Officer in the SOC, you play a critical part in the supply chain operations, manage established contracts and handle procurement of goods and services using the Integrated Logistics Management System (iLMS) to support SOC’s mission and continuity of all operations. You will become part of the logistics fraternity where you get to learn and be au fait with the Government Instruction Manuals (IM) on procurement and finance and be equipped with knowledge to advise and guide officers on procurement procedures. You will work with various logistics departments in MHA and Police HQ.

description: The Municipal Services Office (MSO) was set up in 2014 to improve the coordination, delivery and quality of municipal services by the Government and Town Councils. These services include the upkeep and improvement of common areas in public and private housing estates, and the upgrading or provision of neighbourhood infrastructure. Having reaped these early, low-hanging fruits, MSO and our partner agencies are now on a multi-year effort to more fundamentally integrate and optimise decision-making and ground operations across the sector. We are transforming the way works are scheduled and manpower deployed on the ground, multi-skilling workers to perform several adjacent job functions and deploying operations-technology meaningfully. We piloted this new integrated operations service delivery model, which delivered promising outcomes. The MSO Integrated Operations (IO) team is now working with agencies and industry on the next phase, to scale the integrated operations to more towns, reaping even greater benefits for residents, industry and Government. We are looking for experienced Procurement officers to join the IO team, for this exciting journey to scale up the integrated operations.

description: The Forensics Centre of Expertise (CoE) in HTX plays a critical role in strengthening Singapore’s Home Team forensic capabilities through science, technology, and innovation. Besides genomics, he/she is also expected to participate in research projects involving other areas related to forensic biology.

responsibilities: This role offers a meaningful opportunity to strengthen the risk management frameworks underpinning national family support schemes. You will play a key role in identifying, assessing, and mitigating risks across the GPLS, working closely with internal and external stakeholders to uphold the integrity of public schemes. The key responsibilities are as follows. (a) Risk Management and Framework Development You will be responsible for the development, review, and continuous improvement of risk management frameworks and controls for the GPLS. This includes monitoring emerging risk trends, evaluating the effectiveness of existing controls, and recommending enhancements to risk detection and mitigation strategies. You will also contribute to risk reporting and maintain documentation that supports sound governance and accountability. (b) Risk Assessment and Appeals You will manage the risk assessment phase of the GPLS claims process, reviewing and adjudicating appeals from claimants flagged by the risk detection model. This requires careful evaluation of each case on its merits, sound judgement in determining outcomes, and thorough documentation to ensure decisions are well-supported and defensible. (c) External Audit Oversight You will be responsible for managing appointed external auditors engaged to review the GPLS, ensuring the audit process is conducted effectively and that findings are properly addressed. This includes overseeing procurement, liaising with auditors, and working with stakeholders to address audit observations in a timely manner. (d) Case Management and Follow-up You will manage GPLS cases referred to RMI, reviewing case details and coordinating with the GPLS operations team and other relevant stakeholders to determine and follow through on the appropriate course of action.
requirements: • We are looking for someone who is analytical, meticulous, and driven, with a strong foundation in risk management principles and the ability to assess complex situations and exercise sound judgement. • Experience in risk management, audit, or compliance would be advantageous. • You should be comfortable working both independently and collaboratively and be able to engage effectively with internal and external stakeholders across the public sector. • Strong written and communication skills are essential. Your efforts will contribute to NParks' mission of fostering the best living environment through exceptional nature conservation, greenery, recreation, and veterinary care, in collaboration with the community. Duties include but not limited to: Establish, validate and conduct molecular test and bioinformatic analysis for the identification of targeted domestic and wildlife animal species. Establish and validate genotyping test(s)for targeted animal species. Participate in the maintenance of a laboratory quality system according to ISO17025:2017. Carrying administrative process required to ensure daily function of the laboratory.
requirements: Areas of study in Biology, Biotechnology, Biomedical Science, Life Science, or related fields. At least one year of hands-on experience in a medical or research laboratory preferred. Candidates with relevant job experience and sound knowledge in molecular biology will have an advantage. Highly motivated individual with passion for laboratory work. Team player with initiative, drive and good interpersonal/communication skills and able to work independently. Proficient in Bioinformatics software and tools e.g. Geneious Prime, MEGA, BLAST, etc. Office Location: The Animal & Plant Health Centre 6 Perahu Road, Singapore 718827 Only shortlisted candidates will be notified. Successful candidates will be offered a 11-month employment contract.
description: The Animal & Veterinary Service (AVS), a cluster of NParks, safeguards the health and welfare of animals through comprehensive and integrated programmes and works closely with partners in the veterinary and animal-related industries to strengthen capacities and enhance competencies in animal health and welfare. It also conducts public education and engagement programmes to foster a humane and gracious society for all, where pet owners, communities, and animals co-exist in greater harmony within our City in Nature.

jobTitle: Deputy Manager, Security & Platform Reliability Engineer / IT & Services
responsibilities: Maintain the security posture and system hardening for both on-premises endpoints and cloud IT infrastructure (e.g. AWS, Azure), including the management of Government security monitoring services such as the Government Cyber Security Operations Centre (GCSOC) and Automated Baseline Log Review (ABLR). Maintain and support IT endpoint and infrastructure security tools, including Microsoft Defender, Secure Service Edge, firewalls, and related technologies. Ensure that critical platforms are reliable, scalable, observable, and maintainable; this includes implementing monitoring and observability tools, and leading incident response and root cause analysis to minimise downtime and prevent recurrence. Develop scripts, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), and internal tools to reduce manual intervention and improve operational efficiency and recovery times. Act as a point of contact with the internal security team on security alerts arising from Security Information and Event Management (SIEM), ABLR, and GCSOC, and represent the team in security-related discussions. Participate in infrastructure cyber hygiene reviews with relevant teams and ensure systems comply with recognised standards such as the Centre for Internet Security (CIS), National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST), and Government Technology Agency Instruction Manual for ICT & SS Management. Support regular security assurance activities, including IT audits, penetration testing, and vulnerability assessments, and ensure timely remediation of identified findings. Collaborate across teams to implement security policies and controls, ensuring secure, scalable, and repeatable deployment of IT infrastructure. Manage procurement, projects, and the lifecycle of platform services, including upgrades, maintenance, and deployment of new infrastructure, ensuring security considerations are embedded throughout. Conduct regular reviews of existing on-premises and cloud infrastructure, and provide recommendations to enhance security, performance, and resilience.
requirements: Qualifications in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related discipline. At least 5 years of relevant experience in platform reliability engineering and infrastructure security operations, with familiarity in AWS and Azure cloud architecture. Strong communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex security concepts and issues to non-technical stakeholders. Professional certifications such as CISSP, CEH, AWS, Azure, or other relevant certifications in cybersecurity and platform reliability are advantageous.

responsibilities: The job-holder will be responsible to project manage, ensure deliverables meet business objectives and propose feasible solutions for the identified projects or systems, which include the following: • Work with various key stakeholders to elicit, scope and manage the business requirements • Conceptualise the project, develop the business case for approval • Translate business requirements into Technical specifications • Manage and execute the procurement of the ICT application system in a timely manner • Evaluate and recommend the solution that best address the needs • Manage the vendors to develop and deliver the solution • Identify, manage project risks and implications to the project and to recommend mitigating measures • Manage contractual and payment matters affecting the projects and ensure that systems are operating according to service level agreements • Understand the various prevailing policies and security guidelines and to ensure the system and processes are designed to comply with these policies and guidelines • Drive awareness of the existing products and capabilities in the organisation • Collaborate with product managers on roadmap planning and workforce optimisation
requirements: • Tertiary qualification in Information Technology/Computer Science/Engineering or relevant disciplines. • 3-5 years of relevant working experience preferred. Fresh graduates with strong aptitude and relevant internships/projects are welcome to apply. • Participated in the full software development life cycle (SDLC) is an advantage, with past development experience. • Good analytical, interpersonal, communications, presentation and facilitation skills. • Strong writing skills, preferably with experience in drafting papers for requirements/budget approval. Candidates may be required to submit an essay as part of the selection process. • Competent, self-motivated, pro-active, dedicated and responsible self-starter. • Demonstrate keen interest in keeping up with technology through regular certifications, taking up courses and wide readings on technology matters. • Experience or working knowledge in at least one of the following areas (Cloud, DevSecOps, Agile Methodologies, Data Analytics, Design Thinking) will be an added advantage. All new hires are appointed on a two-year contract in the first instance and will be assessed and considered for permanent tenure over time, based on performance. As part of the shortlisting process for this role, you may be required to complete a medical declaration and/or undergo further assessment. All applicants will be updated on the status of their applications within 4 weeks upon closing of the advertisement. #LI-HL1
description: HTX is the world’s first Science and Technology agency that integrates a diverse range of scientific and engineering capabilities to innovate and deliver transformative and operationally-ready solutions for homeland security. As a statutory board of the Ministry of Home Affairs and integral to the Home Team, HTX works at the forefront of science and technology to empower Singapore’s frontline of security. Our shared mission is to amplify, augment and accelerate the Home Team’s advantage and secure Singapore as the safest place on planet earth. As a Lead Engineer/Engineer, Operational Excellence, Digital Experience Platform, xCloud in HTX, you will collaborate with key stakeholders in the delivery of ICT application systems. This includes eliciting business needs and analysing business problems in order to define and deliver suitable ICT solutions to address business needs.

responsibilities: This portfolio plays a key part in driving the development of food technology innovation and companies in the food manufacturing and emerging food technology space. We are open to candidates at both Development Partner and Senior Development Partner levels. Food Technology Innovation and Startup Development Lead and support work related to the identification, assessment, and development of high-potential foodtech startups, including engagement with relevant industry, research, and investor stakeholders. Contribute to the development and implementation of venture creation support for foodtech R&D spinoffs by working closely with research institutes to support founder matching, technical and business capability building, and corporate engagement to ensure product-market fit. Ecosystem and Industry Collaboration Develop and implement programmes with ecosystem partners supporting Singapore-based foodtech startups, including assessing the technical merit and commercial potential of startup business plans, in alignment with EnterpriseSG's objectives. Food Manufacturing Industry Development Account-manage local food manufacturing companies, understand their growth plans and strategies, and identify and recommend assistance to facilitate the capabilities upgrading and growth of the enterprises. This includes supporting their business growth through innovation and internationalisation, while driving productivity and resource efficiency initiatives to enhance the cost-competitiveness of Singapore food companies. Support talent and leadership development initiatives in food manufacturing and foodtech companies to build organisational capabilities and drive sustainable business growth.
requirements: Competencies Needed Background in food science and technology, agrifood innovation, or a related scientific discipline, with an understanding of the R&D commercialisation landscape and startup ecosystem. Ability to assess the technical feasibility and commercial viability of food technology proposals, and translate scientific research into actionable business and development milestones. Experience in programme or project management, including the ability to manage multiple workstreams and stakeholder relationships concurrently. Strong analytical and strategic thinking skills, with the ability to synthesise complex information and develop well-reasoned recommendations. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage credibly with both technical and business stakeholders. How We Work Together We value individuals who work well with others, communicate clearly, take ownership of their work, and are open to learning and improvement. You should be comfortable navigating change and contributing positively to a collaborative team environment.
description: The Food Manufacturing & Agritech Division drives the development of Singapore's food manufacturing and agrifood technology sectors, in support of the organisation's broader economic objectives. The team works closely with internal and external stakeholders to advance the sustainable growth of these sectors by fostering innovation, driving the commercialisation and internationalisation of our food tech companies, supporting their financing needs, and anchoring high-potential international startups in Singapore.

responsibilities: We are seeking a proactive and passionate individual to lead the development and implementation of central policies that elevate leadership and workforce excellence across the Government Procurement function. This pivotal role will shape talent strategies, design leadership development programs, and drive workforce engagement initiatives in collaboration with both internal and external stakeholders to build a future-ready procurement workforce and strengthen capabilities across government. Key Responsibilities Leadership and Talent Development • Drive the implementation of leadership and talent development strategies for the Government Procurement function, including leadership rotations, succession planning, and talent engagement initiatives to build a strong leadership pipeline across agencies. • Serve as the secretariat for the Joint Finance and Procurement Talent Development Committee and act as the primary liaison with HR counterparts across agencies to coordinate and implement talent initiatives effectively. Career Development and Mobility • Partner with government agencies to design and facilitate cross-agency learning experiences such as Structured Job Rotations (SJR), GIG Projects, Short-Term Immersion Programmes (STIP), and Private Sector Attachment Programmes. • Leverage the One Talent Gateway (OTG) portal to promote transparency and accessibility of career opportunities within the Procurement community. Curate and develop engaging content to help officers better understand various career pathways and growth opportunities. Stakeholder Engagement and Strategic Partnerships • Maintain strong engagement with HR teams across agencies through regular consultations to align development initiatives with agency needs. • Collaborate with private sector and industry partners to co-create impactful attachment opportunities and assess their effectiveness and value. • Work closely with procurement leaders to design developmental initiatives that promote continuous learning and career growth within the procurement workforce. • Foster a vibrant and connected procurement community through networking events and community-building activities. • Provide data-driven insights and performance reporting to senior management to track the effectiveness and outcomes of workforce development efforts.
requirements: What We Look For: • Collaborative Spirit: Strong interpersonal skills to engage effectively with diverse stakeholders and foster productive partnerships. • Transformative Mindset: Passion for driving transformation in public service procurement • Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills. • Adaptability: Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment, manage multiple priorities, and embrace change. • Experience: 3-5 years of relevant experience in workforce planning, leadership and talent development, human resources, or a related field.
description: The Government Procurement Function Office (GPFO) at the Ministry of Finance (MOF) leads procurement transformation and enhances the capabilities of public service procurement officers. responsibilities: Develop and implement sector strategies and programmes to support the growth of Singapore-based Diagnostics and MedTech enterprises, with a focus on medical devices, SaMD, diagnostics, and life science tools. Identify and account manage innovative start-ups and high-growth enterprises, serving as a trusted partner to facilitate their growth, market expansion, and capability development. Engage closely with companies to understand their needs and challenges, and connect them with relevant resources, partners, and funding opportunities. Drive initiatives that support companies' AI and data strategies, including facilitating secure access to research and clinical datasets for product development and validation. Work closely with government agencies and ecosystem partners — including venture builders, incubators, accelerators, and investors — to nurture enterprises and support the broader growth of the industry. Research and analyse local and global trends in Diagnostics, MedTech, Precision Medicine, and healthcare AI, translating insights into actionable strategies and opportunities for Singapore enterprises, and promoting the adoption of industry best practices and emerging technologies. Build and maintain strong relationships with key ecosystem stakeholders, including healthcare institutions, research organisations, industry associations, and regulatory bodies. Represent Enterprise Singapore at industry events, forums, and working groups, and contribute to cross-agency efforts to develop Singapore's healthcare and biomedical ecosystem.
requirements: A degree in Biomedical Sciences, Life Sciences, Engineering, or a related field. A postgraduate qualification is an advantage. At least 3 years of experience in account management or business development, ideally within the MedTech, diagnostics, healthtech, or broader biomedical industry. Prior exposure to digitalisation initiatives or a start-up environment is preferred. Strong understanding of the MedTech and diagnostics landscape, including familiarity with medical device regulatory frameworks and commercialisation pathways. Knowledge of AI and digital health trends, and an appreciation of the data access and governance challenges facing the industry. Analytical mindset with excellent writing and communication skills, and the ability to translate complex information into clear, actionable insights. Keen business acumen with strong relationship-building skills, and a track record of engaging effectively across industry, government, and research communities. How We Work Together We value individuals who demonstrate our CoRE values – collaborating effectively across teams, engaging others with respect, acting with courage to speak up and make decisions, and being enterprising in taking ownership, learning continuously, and driving outcomes in a dynamic environment.

As AI and digitalisation increasingly reshape healthcare and biomedical innovation, you will also lead efforts to help industry players securely access relevant research and clinical data, enabling them to develop and validate data-driven products and solutions.

jobTitle: Lead Engineer/ Engineer, Immigration & Checkpoints Infrastructure & Security

responsibilities: The jobholder is responsible for the Governance, Risk, audit and process management of enterprise ICT infrastructure services systems (such as end-user devices, virtualised infrastructure, active directory, network, serve, etc.) that are across all MHA Home Team Departments (HTDs). The principal accountabilities of the job holder are: • Manage ICT Infrastructure Security Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC). Define business processes and controls. Champion IT Operation automation for compliance. • Serve as Point of Contact for ICT Project Handovers, ensuring "Security by Design". Lead new ICT security initiatives and infrastructure enhancements to comply with government policies. • Execute hands-on network management, troubleshooting, LAN/WAN design, NAC management, firewall configuration and configuration of NOC tools. • Perform Endpoint Infrastructure Management: Directly manage endpoint OS and common service software lifecycle, patching and device policy management. • Manage incidents and vendors to fulfil service levels and take corrective actions. • Manage contracts to ensure vendors meet operational needs. • Identify and evaluate cost-effective technical solutions (e.g., infrastructure refresh). Handle 24/7 Security operations with tight response times. • Lead end-to-end device deployment (laptops, etc.) across agencies. Ensure devices meet security baselines (encryption, hardening). • Manage OEMs for hardware availability. Maintain 100% inventory accuracy.

Personal Characteristics & Behaviours We are looking for motivated individual(s) who: • is excellent in communication (both oral and written) for diverse audiences. • ability to apply risk-based approaches to audits. • has strong project, vendor, and contract-management skills. • can work independently without the need for close supervision, able to prioritize tasks, and remain calm under pressure. • is competent, self-motivated, proactive, dedicated, and responsible. All new appointees will be appointed on a two-year contract in the first instance. We wish to inform that only shortlisted candidates will be notified within 4 weeks upon closing of the advertisement. responsibilities: Key roles and responsibilities: Strategic Oversight of Contract Management: Oversee all CC development contracts across the full project lifecycle, covering pre-construction design stage engagement through construction administration and post-construction final account closure, ensuring contracts are administered in accordance with PA policies, government IMs, and relevant authorities’ requirements. Establish Governance Frameworks: Develop and maintain contract administration, including variation order management, extension of time assessments, loss and expense claims, and final account negotiations, to protect PA's contractual and financial interests and ensure all records are properly maintained and audit-ready. Provide Expert Contractual Advice: Advise senior management on complex or contentious contract matters, including dispute resolution and claims management, to achieve timely and cost-effective outcomes. Monitor Contract Performance: Track key milestones, financial commitments, and contractor performance across the development portfolio to identify risks early and implement appropriate mitigation measures. Manage Stakeholders and Contracting Parties Relationships: Build and maintain effective working relationships with project divisions, consultants, and contracting parties, ensuring PA's positions are clearly communicated,appropriately documented and consistently upheld. Develop Cost Intelligence: Lead development of construction cost database and analytics to support benchmarking, planning, and decision-making across the development portfolio. Align Project Cost Planning, Budgeting, and Financial Submissions with Corporate Finance Division requirements. Drive Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities to streamline contract management workflows, strengthen governance controls, and leverage technology to enhance efficiency, transparency and audit readiness. Build Team Capability and Manage Resources: Lead capability development across the unit, building team competencies in contract administration and governance, while managing budget, manpower planning, and workplan development to ensure the unit operates sustainably and delivers on its mandate.
requirements: Professional Qualification: Relevant professional qualification in building, construction management, quantity surveying, or a related field. Professional certificates such as Singapore Institute of Surveyors & Valuers, Quantity Surveyor’s accreditation is an added advantage. Experience: Minimum 15 years working experience in the infrastructure/building field and with experience leading a team. Prior experience in procurement and/or contracts management in a statutory board or government agency context and familiarity with BCA procurement frameworks (e.g. PQM, QFM), GeBIZ and the Government Instruction Manual. Experience managing development project across the full project cycle (i.e. from design to post construction) with minimum project cost of $30 million. Knowledge and experience with (i) dispute resolution mechanisms such as adjudication or mediation, and (ii) collaborative contracting for development and/or facilities management contracts, will be an added advantage. Skills: Good knowledge of construction contract law, standard forms of contract (e.g. PSSCOC), and variation/claims management. Sound judgment in contract governance and dispute resolution. Good leadership qualities – ability to lead and drive teams to perform and achieve desired outcomes, sectoral knowledge and can think strategically. Good interpersonal and communication skills to engage stakeholders (internal and external). Self-driven individual who champions excellence, innovation and digitalisation. Familiarity with Building Information Modelling (BIM) and digital contract management tools will be an added advantage. Only shortlisted candidates whose qualifications and experience best meet our requirements will be contacted.
description: The Deputy Director (Contract Management – Development) leads the end-to-end contract management function for all PA development project contracts, spanning the full project lifecycle from pre-construction design stage through to post-construction final account closure. Working closely with project divisions, consultants, and contractors, the role serves as the expert contractual voice to senior management and drives consistent contract administration standards across the development portfolio, while building a high-performing team and maintaining robust governance frameworks that uphold PA's standards of integrity and operational excellence.

responsibilities: As a member of the team based at Sungei Buloh Wetland Reserve, you will be in an outdoor environment dedicated to conservation operations work. Your primary focus will be on the collation and in-depth analysis of recent census and migration data gathered by the team. You will leverage your strong data analysis to extract meaningful insights from this data. In addition to data analysis, you will also support the organisation and management of long-term bird census, bird ringing and satellite tracking datasets, helping to maintain their quality, consistency and long-term usability for conservation and research. You will also provide essential support for the broader operational needs of SBNPN, which include daily patrols, engaging outreach activities, and weekend duty.

description: The Sungei Buloh Nature Park Network (SBNPN) comprises Sungei Buloh Wetland Reserve (SBWR), Kranji Marshes, Kranji Coastal Nature Park, Lim Chu Kang Nature Park and Mandai Mangrove and Mudflat. Together, these sites form an interconnected network of wetland, mangrove, freshwater and coastal habitats that support a rich diversity of biodiversity and provide opportunities for conservation, research, education and nature-based recreation. Bird monitoring and migration studies have been conducted at Sungei Buloh Wetland Reserve since the 1990s, with long-distance migrant tracking initiated in 2014. These sustained efforts have yielded a rich, multi-year dataset of bird census and migration data, supporting conservation management, ecological research and informed decision-making across the nature park network.

responsibilities: Lead the end-to-end delivery of software and digital platform projects, ensuring successful outcomes within agreed scope, budget, quality and schedule. Own and drive Agile software delivery processes across the project lifecycle. Serve as Scrum Master and delivery lead where required, organising, facilitating and ensuring the effectiveness of all Scrum ceremonies, including sprint planning, backlog refinement, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews and retrospectives. Work closely with Product Owners and stakeholders to define, refine and prioritise epics, features and user stories, ensuring development teams have a clear and actionable backlog. Track sprint goals, team velocity, burn-down metrics, dependencies and delivery risks, taking proactive actions to maintain delivery momentum and predictability. Remove impediments and facilitate resolution of issues that may impact software delivery. Serve as the primary interface between business stakeholders, product owners, vendors and software engineering teams. Translate business requirements into clear technical deliverables and work packages for engineering teams. Work closely with software architects and engineers to evaluate solution designs, implementation approaches, technical risks and trade-offs. Coordinate internal and external engineering resources to ensure effective delivery and resource utilisation. Monitor project health, identify risks and dependencies, and drive timely mitigation and resolution. Manage stakeholder communications and provide regular updates on project status, key decisions, risks and milestones. Oversee project governance, documentation, procurement activities and vendor performance where applicable. Ensure software solutions comply with cybersecurity, architecture, operational and organisational requirements. Foster collaboration between multidisciplinary teams including software engineers, infrastructure engineers, cybersecurity specialists, data professionals and business users. Support tender and procurement activities, including requirements definition, technical evaluations and vendor engagements.
requirements: Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering or equivalent. Minimum 7 years of relevant experience in software delivery, digital transformation, product delivery or technology programme management. Proven track record of leading software development projects from concept through delivery and operations. Strong understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC), Agile methodologies and modern engineering practices. Demonstrated experience leading Agile software delivery teams using Scrum methodologies. Proven experience facilitating sprint planning, backlog grooming, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews and retrospectives. Strong understanding of Agile metrics such as velocity, burn-down charts, cycle time and release planning. Able to engage confidently with software engineers, solution architects and technical specialists on system design, architecture, integration and delivery considerations. Experience managing vendors, system integrators and multidisciplinary project teams. Familiarity with cloud platforms, APIs, enterprise software systems and modern application architectures. Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to engage both technical and non-technical audiences. Demonstrated ability to manage competing priorities, resolve issues and drive delivery in complex project environments. Team player with strong people management, facilitation and conflict resolution skills. Ideal Candidate Profile: The successful candidate is not expected to write code, but should possess sufficient software engineering knowledge and delivery experience to challenge assumptions and proposals from vendors and engineering teams. Understand software architecture and engineering trade-offs. Facilitate productive discussions between business and technical stakeholders. Drive Agile software delivery and project governance. Make informed decisions on delivery risks, timelines and dependencies.

responsibilities: - Lead and conduct penetration testing, red teaming, and adversary simulation activities across web, mobile, infrastructure, cloud, OT, and telecommunications environments. - Execute realistic attack scenarios to assess the resilience of Critical Information Infrastructure (CII), including systems supporting essential services. - Support purple-teaming activities by translating offensive techniques into actionable detection and response improvements. - Lead engagements end-to-end, including planning, execution, reporting, and technical debriefs with stakeholders. - Mentor junior consultants and contribute to raising the team’s overall technical standard. - Drive continuous improvement of ASG’s testing methodologies, tooling, and research, including taking on problem spaces outside your primary domain when required. - And because this is government, be prepared to occasionally switch gears by contributing to strategic initiatives, supporting and executing procurement activities, participating in industry outreach, or undertaking coordination work, all of which ultimately help us strengthen security outcomes and make Singapore a safer place to live and work. Why Join ASG at CSA - Work on nationally significant systems, including CII, OT, and telecommunications environments rarely accessible outside government. - Engage in deep, technically challenging work that prioritises realism, learning, and security outcomes over high-volume testing. - Apply your offensive security expertise to a public mission that directly contributes to Singapore’s cyber resilience. - Be part of a specialist team that is deliberately building towards strong technical depth, continuous learning, and moving beyond compliance-driven assurance, and help shape what “good” looks like along the way.
requirements: - An attacker’s mindset with strong technical understanding of operating systems, networks, and modern enterprise environments. - Proven ability to identify and execute real-world attack scenarios, beyond automated or checklist-based testing. - Experience in penetration testing and/or red team operations, with exposure to adversary tradecraft and attack chaining. - Demonstrated adaptability to transfer skills across technical domains (e.g. web to mobile, IT to OT, on-prem to cloud). - Strong technical writing skills and the ability to clearly articulate security risks and impact. - Typically 5–8 years of relevant experience in penetration testing, red team operations, or related offensive security roles, with demonstrated depth in hands-on technical work. - Relevant industry certifications such as OSCP, CREST (e.g. CRT, CCT), CRTO, or equivalent are desirable. - That said, we recognise that certifications alone do not define capability. Hands-on experience, problem-solving ability, and technical depth matter more to us than badges.
description: You will be part of the Attack Simulation Group (ASG) within the Cyber Security Agency of Singapore (CSA), a specialist team responsible for delivering advanced security testing and adversary-led assessments to strengthen the resilience of Critical Information Infrastructure (CII). This is a senior, hands-on role for experienced offensive security practitioners who want to apply real-world attack techniques to complex, high-impact systems in support of Singapore’s national cyber security mission. ASG is a technically driven team within CSA focused on realistic attack simulation, penetration testing, red teaming, and purple-teaming outcomes. Our work goes beyond compliance-driven assurance, emphasising hands-on testing, attacker tradecraft, and practical security improvements. Operating within the realities of government, we value curiosity, adaptability, and out-of-the-box thinking. Specialised training and development opportunities are provided to continuously deepen and expand our technical capabilities, and team members are expected to continuously learn, apply skills across domains, and contribute to the evolution of attack simulation practices across Singapore’s CII. We also believe in sharing and growing our craft where appropriate. Some of our public work and tooling can be found at: 👉 https://github.com/hack-techv2/

The project integrates two proprietary technologies: • DuoBioSonic – Dual-frequency ultrasonic cavitation for controlling pathogens, algae, biofilm, and turbidity. • AquAPEX – Multicellular graphite electrolysis for ammonia and nitrogen removal. The successful candidate will contribute to prototype development, laboratory research, system integration, water quality analysis, field validation at commercial fish farms, and technology commercialisation.

description: Are you ready to build next-generation, sustainable cold chain logistics for life-saving biopharmaceuticals? Republic Polytechnic's School of Engineering (SEG), in strategic partnership with industry leader SSW Group, is seeking an ambitious full-time Research Staff (12-month contract) to engineer an industrial-scale 1"m" ^3 self-sustained passive cold storage platform under a DGF-funded initiative. Current biopharmaceutical distribution relies on massive active energy inputs and heavy daily coolant consumption. This project completely disrupts that model by building a zero-power-in-transit, high-performance thermal container (1"m"×1"m"×1"m" ) capable of locking in sub-zero temperatures (2–8°C) for over 72 continuous hours in harsh tropical environments. Beyond standard transport, this passive design provides critical fail-safe protection against warehouse power outages and opens up new pathways for long-haul air and sea freight to distant international markets without relying on active electrical refrigeration networks. You will lead the hands-on engineering across two breakthrough technological pillars: - Active-Passive "Flash-Charging" Cryogenic System: A rapid-charging base station interface utilizing specialized heat exchangers and Liquid Nitrogen (LN_2) bursts to charge high-density Phase Change Material (PCM) cores and Vacuum Insulated Panels (VIP). - Triple-Vector IoT Telemetry Engine: An ultra-low-power, cloud-connected sensor matrix tracking real-time Temperature, Relative Humidity, and Oxygen (O_2) levels to ensure absolute data transparency and regulatory compliance (HSA/FDA standards). The successful candidate will contribute to prototype development, laboratory research, system integration, cold box temperature analysis, field validation at mimic cold storage environment, and technology commercialisation.

responsibilities: As Manager, Bus Procurement, you will play a key role in shaping Singapore's next-generation public bus fleet. By 2030, we will be replacing half of our 6,000-strong bus fleet with cutting-edge electric vehicles, and this role will place you at the forefront of this historic transition. Working at the intersection of engineering, policy, and sustainability, you will support strategic bus procurement initiatives that directly influence fleet performance, passenger experience, and long-term asset resilience. Your work will take you beyond Singapore's borders as you scout emerging technologies and collaborate with global manufacturers to bring the most advanced solutions to our streets. You'll witness firsthand the latest innovations in electric propulsion, autonomous systems, and smart connectivity as you help modernise a fleet that's not just safe and reliable, but also future-ready. You will support diverse and impactful responsibilities encompassing comprehensive end-to-end bus procurement and strategic asset management, including: • Support Fleet Renewal and Replacement: Assist in developing and executing strategies to renew and replace fleet to meet operational, safety, and sustainability objectives across the public bus network. • Tender Specifications & Evaluation: Support the drafting of new bus requirements, preparation of tender specifications, and evaluation of submissions to ensure the best value for the fleet. • Quality Assurance: Conduct pre-delivery inspections and testing of bus equipment to ensure they comply with contract specifications and operational standards. • Partnership Management: Build and nurture strong relationships with overseas bus manufacturers and suppliers, staying informed on industry innovations and product developments. • Market Research & Design Specifications: Conduct in-depth research into emerging bus technologies and trends, making recommendations for design requirements to inform design improvements and future tender specifications. • Procurement Budget: Support cost-effective purchasing while maintaining high standards of quality, all within the boundaries of the procurement budget. Your work will directly support the advancement of Singapore's public bus fleet, enhance operational excellence and sustainability outcomes, and contribute to maintaining Singapore's position as a global leader in innovative and future-ready public transport solutions.
requirements: We are seeking someone who has a passion for public transport and asset management. The ideal candidate will possess: Educational Background : Knowledge in Engineering (Electrical, Electrical & Electronic, Mechanical, Automotive or equivalent). Experience : At least 4 years of relevant experience in automotive, engineering, or related industries. Familiarity with battery systems, servicing, and maintenance of buses will be advantageous. Fresh graduates are welcome to apply. Skills : Strong analytical, planning, and problem-solving abilities with attention to detail. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, alongside proficiency in IT. Attributes : A proactive, self-motivated individual with the ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities effectively. As part of the shortlisting process for the role, you may be required to complete a medical declaration and / or undergo further assessment.
